The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

j.description: Lövsta agricultural research We are looking for someone who wants to work as a stable technician in the cow stable at SLU, Lövsta agricultural research outside Uppsala. We are close to thirty employees in the team at Lövsta where half work with the dairy cow herd of 300 cows with recruitment and about 6 employees work in the pig barn where the pig herd includes 110 sows with integrated production. The barns are highly mechanized with, among other things, milking robots (VMS) in the cow barn. The business annually carries out 20 research projects and receives a couple of thousand SLU students. About the job We are looking for you who want to work with the usual chores in a dairy cow herd such as supervision in stables and on pasture, cleaning, registrations, administration, weighing and feeding. The work is scheduled with weekend and standby work. Some work can occur in Lövsta's chicken and laying hen barn, whose operations are integrated with the cow barn. The daily work is interspersed with tasks that are connected to the research activities and as support in the teaching. Your background You must have practical experience of working with farm animals and milk production, theoretical knowledge is an advantage. We attach great importance to personal qualities such as cooperation, independence, and initiative and organizational skills. You must be interested in working with researchers and students. B driving license is a requirement. It is advantageous if you have attended a seminar course and/or course in pharmaceutical management and if you have experience driving a tractor. About us Lövsta Agricultural Research at the Swedish University of Agriculture is one of Europe's most modern facilities for research and teaching on farm animals. j.description: To Framtidsgården Bjertorp we are now looking for you with a great interest in future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging and happy team with high tempo during the season 2025.bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruks Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We conduct a modern and rational agriculture of 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens property, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The experimental operations comprise about 20 hectares and 6,000 trial savings cells that are distributed over the farm's area. The employment is a seasonal employment for the 2025 season, with access on April 1 and runs until October 31. There is the possibility of an extension, and access is made by arrangement. This will be done with other staff you will primarily manage the choirs to be carried out on a plant cultivation farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and grazing harvest at Viken. You will also help with sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loading machine driving and machine maintenance is available. All work in fields is performed with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest mechanical engineering to ensure high efficiency, precision and sustainability. This you need to succeed and thrive: - an agricultural education (or multi -year experience in the profession) - experience in machine driving and a great interest in agriculture - B -driving license - Good knowledge of the Swedish language you are: - Responsible and accurate in your work - a team layer that can collaborate with others in your area, but who can also work independently - syringe certificates are meritherydu share our values ​​openness, holistic approach and action - And our promise to take responsibility from land to table. What we offer the Digen exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you get the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment will take up by an agreement, with the desirable start date from April 1 to October 31. There is the possibility of extension. Place of placement for the service is Kvänum, where you will report to the operator. If needed, there is the possibility of housing. You apply for the online service, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28 2025. Selection is ongoing. If you have any questions regarding the service or recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com.lanten is an agricultural cooperative and northern Europe's leading player in agriculture, machine, bioenergy and food. We are owned by 18,000 Swedish farmers, have 12,000 employees, have operations in some 20 countries and have a turnover of approximately SEK 70 billion on an annual basis. With the base in cereals, we refine arable land resources for viable agriculture. Some of our most well -known brands in food are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, sausage bread bag, GoGreen, Finn Crisp and Bonjour. Our company is based on knowledge and values ​​that have existed for generations with our owners. Through research, development and activities throughout the value chain, we together take responsibility from land to table. Read more at www.lantmannen.se.

j.description: We are looking for reinforcements for our plant growing group. You who are applying have suitable experience and will be part of a work team with competence in crop cultivation, farm animals, field trials, research and development, nature conservation, economics, and forestry as well as food and health. Do you value a workplace where freedom, good camaraderie between colleagues and interesting and developmental tasks are everyday? Then you fit with us! Together with curious colleagues, you will be involved in developing our advisory concept for agricultural companies in Dalarna in particular. We are looking for you who are passionate about agriculture and rural issues and who enjoy taking personal responsibility and building good customer relationships. Your main tasks are to provide advice both in the field and from the office and to be a sounding board for customers. The work also includes preparing SAM applications, writing articles and plant breeding letters as well as arranging courses and customer meetings, etc. We want the applicant to: Have the appropriate education for the position (agronomist, farm manager, agrotechnician or equivalent) with a focus on plant growing Is well versed in plant growing agriculture, preferably with expertise in animal production and production economicsExperience in advising agricultural companies is a plusStimulated by own responsibility for resultsExpertise in pasture issues with an interest in feed value/feed advice and chemical knowledge. Location: Primarily Stora Skedvi alternatively Storvik. Your application is welcome! For more information: Business area manager: Ylva Azcarate 0730-39 14 25 Subject area manager: Line Strand 070-207 33 07 Union contact person: Ylva Andersson 073-336 76 69 The service is a permanent full-time employment. The workplace is covered by a collective agreement. We want applications with a personal letter and CV no later than January 31, 2025. Interviews will take place continuously and employment may become available before the end of the application period. j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. j.description: Lövsta agricultural research We are looking for someone who wants to work as a stable technician in the cow stable at SLU, Lövsta agricultural research outside Uppsala. We are close to thirty employees in the team at Lövsta where half work with the dairy cow herd of 300 cows with recruitment and about 6 employees work in the pig barn where the pig herd includes 110 sows with integrated production. The barns are highly mechanized with, among other things, milking robots (VMS) in the cow barn. The business annually carries out 20 research projects and receives a couple of thousand SLU students. About the job We are looking for you who want to work with the usual chores in a dairy cow herd such as supervision in stables and on pasture, cleaning, registrations, administration, weighing and feeding. The work is scheduled with weekend and standby work. Some work can occur in Lövsta's chicken and laying hen barn, whose operations are integrated with the cow barn. The daily work is interspersed with tasks that are connected to the research activities and as support in the teaching. Your background You must have practical experience of working with farm animals and milk production, theoretical knowledge is an advantage. We attach great importance to personal qualities such as cooperation, independence, and initiative and organizational skills. You must be interested in working with researchers and students. B driving license is a requirement. It is advantageous if you have attended a seminar course and/or course in pharmaceutical management and if you have experience driving a tractor. About us Lövsta Agricultural Research at the Swedish University of Agriculture is one of Europe's most modern facilities for research and teaching on farm animals. In the stables, there is extensive production with pigs, dairy cows and poultry. The stables are used daily by students and researchers at SLU. j.description: 公司描述Syngenta Group is a global leader in agriculture; rooted in science and dedicated to bringing plat potential to life. A core player in the field of agricultural technology and life science innovation, and one of the world's largest agricultural innovation and technology companies, our products and services cover the entire chain of crop protection, seeds, crop nutrition and modern agricultural platforms. With a history dating back more than 250 years, the Group employs nearly 60,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. ### Skills and Competences
These are practical applications and professional capabilities:
*   **Research & Technical Skills:** Perform scientific research, use agronomic modelling, manage research data, manage findable/accessible/interoperable/reusable (FAIR) data, draft scientific/academic papers and technical documentation, and write scientific publications.
*   **Project & Resource Management:** Perform project management, manage fisheries projects, advise on irrigation projects, inspect project regulations, create soil and plant improvement programmes, and manage intellectual property rights.
*   **Advisory & Training:** Provide advice to farmers, provide advice to hatcheries, advise on soil and water protection, advise on efficiency improvements, teach in academic or vocational contexts, train employees, train staff on recycling programs, mentor individuals, and educate on recycling regulations.
*   **Leadership & Collaboration:** Lead a team, evaluate employees' work, identify process improvements, promote open innovation in research, promote the transfer of knowledge, increase the impact of science on policy and society, and develop professional networks with researchers and scientists.
*   **Compliance & Monitoring:** Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, comply with legal regulations, comply with farm regulations, report pollution incidents, report on environmental issues, and monitor the farm environmental management plan.
*   **Professional Development:** Manage personal professional development, interact professionally in research and professional environments, apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles, apply blended learning, and speak different languages.
*   **Other:** Apply precision farming, assess new farming technologies, cultivate crops for biomass, perform market research, disseminate results to the scientific community, operate open source software, evaluate research activities, communicate with a non-scientific audience, think abstractly, synthesise information, conduct research across disciplines, promote the participation of citizens in scientific research, and integrate gender dimensions in research.

### Knowledge
These represent the theoretical understanding required for the role:
*   **Agricultural Systems:** Conservation agriculture, climate smart agriculture, integrated food-energy systems, organic farming, agroecology, agroforestry, livestock farming systems, and e-agriculture.
*   **Policy & Management:** Environmental policy, environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry, bioeconomy, project management principles, and project management.

j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. j.description: We are looking for a machine operator in agriculture for the crop growing season 2025. As part of our team at Ultuna property, you will work on an agricultural farm at the forefront with close proximity to research, trials and students. About the job You are offered a varied job with great personal responsibility and many contact areas and development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. With us, you will perform, among other things, tillage, transport, inspection of crops, machine work and more. You will work in our regular team, which consists of the operations manager, a farm manager and two machine operators. Together with them, you are responsible for tending and salvaging this year's grain harvest. To help you, you have a modern fleet of machines that you also look after and maintain. The job is seasonal employment according to agreement during the period June-September 2025. Certain overtime work on weekends and evenings may occur. Your background We are looking for you who have a great interest in agriculture, experience as a machine operator in crop cultivation and driver's license B. Driver's license for a loading machine and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L are meritorious. We will place great emphasis on personal suitability. About us On the Ultuna property, we usually have around 1300 crops and pasture. The plant cultivation is both conventional and organic and approx. 90-140 hectares are plant cultivation trials or trial farms. j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

### Skills and Competences
These are practical applications and professional capabilities:
*   **Research & Technical Skills:** Perform scientific research, use agronomic modelling, manage research data, manage findable/accessible/interoperable/reusable (FAIR) data, draft scientific/academic papers and technical documentation, and write scientific publications.
*   **Project & Resource Management:** Perform project management, manage fisheries projects, advise on irrigation projects, inspect project regulations, create soil and plant improvement programmes, and manage intellectual property rights.
*   **Advisory & Training:** Provide advice to farmers, provide advice to hatcheries, advise on soil and water protection, advise on efficiency improvements, teach in academic or vocational contexts, train employees, train staff on recycling programs, mentor individuals, and educate on recycling regulations.
*   **Leadership & Collaboration:** Lead a team, evaluate employees' work, identify process improvements, promote open innovation in research, promote the transfer of knowledge, increase the impact of science on policy and society, and develop professional networks with researchers and scientists.
*   **Compliance & Monitoring:** Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, comply with legal regulations, comply with farm regulations, report pollution incidents, report on environmental issues, and monitor the farm environmental management plan.
*   **Professional Development:** Manage personal professional development, interact professionally in research and professional environments, apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles, apply blended learning, and speak different languages.
*   **Other:** Apply precision farming, assess new farming technologies, cultivate crops for biomass, perform market research, disseminate results to the scientific community, operate open source software, evaluate research activities, communicate with a non-scientific audience, think abstractly, synthesise information, conduct research across disciplines, promote the participation of citizens in scientific research, and integrate gender dimensions in research.

### Knowledge

*   **Agricultural Systems:** Conservation agriculture, climate smart agriculture, integrated food-energy systems, organic farming, agroecology, agroforestry, livestock farming systems, and e-agriculture.
*   **Policy & Management:** Environmental policy, environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry, bioeconomy, project management principles, and project management.

            "j.title: F\u00f6rs\u00f6ksassistent\nj.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara.             "j.title: F\u00f6rs\u00f6kstekniker till Borgeby/Helgeg\u00e5rden\nj.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hush\u00e5llningss\u00e4llskapet Sk\u00e5ne!Hush\u00e5llningss\u00e4llskapet Sk\u00e5ne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Sk\u00e5ne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges.             "j.title: Stalltekniker\nj.description: L\u00f6vsta agricultural research We are looking for someone who wants to work as a stable technician in the cow stable at SLU, L\u00f6vsta agricultural research outside Uppsala.             "j.title: Traktorf\u00f6rare S\u00e4song 2025\nj.description: To Framtidsg\u00e5rden Bjertorp we are now looking for you with a great interest in future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging and happy team with high tempo during the season 2025.bjertorp's property is Lantm\u00e4nnen Lantbruks Framtidsg\u00e5rd in V\u00e4stra G\u00f6taland, Sweden.             "j.title: V\u00e4xtodlingsr\u00e5dgivare Dalarna\nj.description: We are looking for reinforcements for our plant growing group. Do you value a workplace where freedom, good camaraderie between colleagues and interesting and developmental tasks are everyday? Then you fit with us! Together with curious colleagues, you will be involved in developing our advisory concept for agricultural companies in Dalarna in particular. We are looking for you who are passionate about agriculture and rural issues and who enjoy taking personal responsibility and building good customer relationships. Your main tasks are to provide advice both in the field and from the office and to be a sounding board for customers. The role involves gathering and transferring knowledge regarding milk production, animal health, and new technology. (Posted 2024-10-17)
*   **Syngenta Group China Scientist:** Requires a PhD in agriculture, plant sciences, plant pathology, bioinformatics, soil science, or related fields. This role involves driving innovation in seeds, crop protection, and crop nutrition. (Posted 2024-10-29)

*   **Land and Agricultural Estate Operations Director:** Requires an Agricultural Engineer or at least a BTSA in Agronomy, crop production, or animal production, with experience in managing agricultural operations. (Posted 2024-09-05 and 2024-10-04)
*   **PhD Positions:**
    *   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding:** Requires a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. (Posted 2025-02-09)
    *   **PhD Student Position in Land Sector Sustainability Transitions:** Requires a master's degree in a relevant field, preferably environmental science, agricultural science, or engineering science. (Posted 2025-03-18)
    *   **PhD Position within Sustainable Feed for Poultry and Pigs:** Requires a degree in Agricultural Science, Animal Science, Biology, or another relevant field at an advanced level. (Posted 2024-11-27)
*   **Postdoc Positions:**
    *   **Postdoc - Plant breeding towards nutritional quality in cereals:** Requires a PhD in agriculture, biology, plant breeding, or a related field. (Posted 2024-11-26)

Additionally, several roles for "Agricultural Engineer," "Operations Manager," or "Plant Engineering Consultant" list agricultural science degrees or comparable professional training as requirements or qualifications.

j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Stalltekniker
j.description: Lövsta agricultural research We are looking for someone who wants to work as a stable technician in the cow stable at SLU, Lövsta agricultural research outside Uppsala. We are close to thirty employees in the team at Lövsta where half work with the dairy cow herd of 300 cows with recruitment and about 6 employees work in the pig barn where the pig herd includes 110 sows with integrated production. The barns are highly mechanized with, among other things, milking robots (VMS) in the cow barn. The business annually carries out 20 research projects and receives a couple of thousand SLU students. About the job We are looking for you who want to work with the usual chores in a dairy cow herd such as supervision in stables and on pasture, cleaning, registrations, administration, weighing and feeding. The work is scheduled with weekend and standby work. Some work can occur in Lövsta's chicken and laying hen barn, whose operations are integrated with the cow barn. The daily work is interspersed with tasks that are connected to the research activities and as support in the teaching. Your background You must have practical experience of working with farm animals and milk production, theoretical knowledge is an advantage. We attach great importance to personal qualities such as cooperation, independence, and initiative and organizational skills. You must be interested in working with researchers and students. B driving license is a requirement. It is advantageous if you have attended a seminar course and/or course in pharmaceutical management and if you have experience driving a tractor. About us Lövsta Agricultural Research at the Swedish University of Agriculture is one of Europe's most modern facilities for research and teaching on farm animals. In the stables, there is extensive production with pigs, dairy cows and poultry. The stables are used daily by students and researchers at SLU. j.title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
j.description: To Framtidsgården Bjertorp we are now looking for you with a great interest in future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging and happy team with high tempo during the season 2025.bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruks Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We conduct a modern and rational agriculture of 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens property, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The experimental operations comprise about 20 hectares and 6,000 trial savings cells that are distributed over the farm's area. The employment is a seasonal employment for the 2025 season, with access on April 1 and runs until October 31. There is the possibility of an extension, and access is made by arrangement. This will be done with other staff you will primarily manage the choirs to be carried out on a plant cultivation farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and grazing harvest at Viken. You will also help with sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loading machine driving and machine maintenance is available. All work in fields is performed with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest mechanical engineering to ensure high efficiency, precision and sustainability. This you need to succeed and thrive: - an agricultural education (or multi -year experience in the profession) - experience in machine driving and a great interest in agriculture - B -driving license - Good knowledge of the Swedish language you are: - Responsible and accurate in your work - a team layer that can collaborate with others in your area, but who can also work independently - syringe certificates are meritherydu share our values ​​openness, holistic approach and action - And our promise to take responsibility from land to table. What we offer the Digen exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you get the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment will take up by an agreement, with the desirable start date from April 1 to October 31. There is the possibility of extension. Place of placement for the service is Kvänum, where you will report to the operator. If needed, there is the possibility of housing. You apply for the online service, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28 2025. Selection is ongoing. If you have any questions regarding the service or recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com.lanten is an agricultural cooperative and northern Europe's leading player in agriculture, machine, bioenergy and food. We are owned by 18,000 Swedish farmers, have 12,000 employees, have operations in some 20 countries and have a turnover of approximately SEK 70 billion on an annual basis. With the base in cereals, we refine arable land resources for viable agriculture. Some of our most well -known brands in food are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, sausage bread bag, GoGreen, Finn Crisp and Bonjour. Our company is based on knowledge and values ​​that have existed for generations with our owners. Through research, development and activities throughout the value chain, we together take responsibility from land to table. Read more at www.lantmannen.se.
