j.title: Växtodlingsrådgivare Dalarna
j.description: We are looking for reinforcements for our plant growing group. You who are applying have suitable experience and will be part of a work team with competence in crop cultivation, farm animals, field trials, research and development, nature conservation, economics, and forestry as well as food and health. Do you value a workplace where freedom, good camaraderie between colleagues and interesting and developmental tasks are everyday? Then you fit with us! Together with curious colleagues, you will be involved in developing our advisory concept for agricultural companies in Dalarna in particular. We are looking for you who are passionate about agriculture and rural issues and who enjoy taking personal responsibility and building good customer relationships. Your main tasks are to provide advice both in the field and from the office and to be a sounding board for customers. The work also includes preparing SAM applications, writing articles and plant breeding letters as well as arranging courses and customer meetings, etc. We want the applicant to: Have the appropriate education for the position (agronomist, farm manager, agrotechnician or equivalent) with a focus on plant growing Is well versed in plant growing agriculture, preferably with expertise in animal production and production economicsExperience in advising agricultural companies is a plusStimulated by own responsibility for resultsExpertise in pasture issues with an interest in feed value/feed advice and chemical knowledge. Location: Primarily Stora Skedvi alternatively Storvik. Your application is welcome! For more information: Business area manager: Ylva Azcarate 0730-39 14 25 Subject area manager: Line Strand 070-207 33 07 Union contact person: Ylva Andersson 073-336 76 69 The service is a permanent full-time employment. The workplace is covered by a collective agreement. We want applications with a personal letter and CV no later than January 31, 2025. Interviews will take place continuously and employment may become available before the end of the application period. HS Konsult AB sells independent advice to agricultural companies in Uppsala, Stockholm, Södermanland, Västmanland, Örebro, Gävleborg and Dalarna counties. turns.content: What competences are required for that occupation?

Based on the information provided from the database for the occupation of an Agricultural Scientist (linked to ID `c25b3700-6095-42b7-99fc-b87dc326c044`), the required skills and knowledge are categorized below:

### Skills and Competences
These are practical applications and professional capabilities:
*   **Research & Technical Skills:** Perform scientific research, use agronomic modelling, manage research data, manage findable/accessible/interoperable/reusable (FAIR) data, draft scientific/academic papers and technical documentation, and write scientific publications.
*   **Project & Resource Management:** Perform project management, manage fisheries projects, advise on irrigation projects, inspect project regulations, create soil and plant improvement programmes, and manage intellectual property rights.
*   **Advisory & Training:** Provide advice to farmers, provide advice to hatcheries, advise on soil and water protection, advise on efficiency improvements, teach in academic or vocational contexts, train employees, train staff on recycling programs, mentor individuals, and educate on recycling regulations.
*   **Leadership & Collaboration:** Lead a team, evaluate employees' work, identify process improvements, promote open innovation in research, promote the transfer of knowledge, increase the impact of science on policy and society, and develop professional networks with researchers and scientists.
*   **Compliance & Monitoring:** Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, comply with legal regulations, comply with farm regulations, report pollution incidents, report on environmental issues, and monitor the farm environmental management plan.
*   **Professional Development:** Manage personal professional development, interact professionally in research and professional environments, apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles, apply blended learning, and speak different languages.
*   **Other:** Apply precision farming, assess new farming technologies, cultivate crops for biomass, perform market research, disseminate results to the scientific community, operate open source software, evaluate research activities, communicate with a non-scientific audience, think abstractly, synthesise information, conduct research across disciplines, promote the participation of citizens in scientific research, and integrate gender dimensions in research.

### Knowledge
These represent the theoretical understanding required for the role:
*   **Agricultural Systems:** Conservation agriculture, climate smart agriculture, integrated food-energy systems, organic farming, agroecology, agroforestry, livestock farming systems, and e-agriculture.
*   **Policy & Management:** Environmental policy, environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry, bioeconomy, project management principles, and project management.
*   **Research & Communication:** Consultation methods, multidisciplinary research, scientific literature, and research design.

turns.content: Are there any other occupations that require knowledge of environmental protection and sustainability regulations?

Although there is no information exactly related to the original question concerning "Agricultural Scientist" in the context of the initial query, the database provides a list of several other occupations that involve knowledge of environmental protection, sustainability, and related regulations. 

These occupations include:

*   **Environmental scientist:** Identifies problems and finds solutions to minimize environmental hazards, develops environmental policies, and ensures environmental regulations are followed.
*   **Environmental protection manager:** Provides advice on the development of environmental policies and manages campaigns aimed at waste collection, landfills, and green area preservation.
*   **Sustainability manager:** Assists in the design and implementation of plans to ensure manufacturing processes and products comply with environmental regulations and social responsibility standards.
*   **Environmental programme coordinator:** Develops programmes for environmental sustainability and efficiency and monitors an organisation's compliance with environmental legislation.
*   **Environmental health inspector:** Carries out investigations to ensure organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation.
*   **Waste management officer:** Develops and implements rules for waste disposal, collection, and recycling and evaluates compliance with existing legislation.
*   **Industrial waste inspector:** Conducts controls in companies to ensure they comply with waste and environmental regulations.
*   **Hazardous waste inspector:** Inspects industrial sites to ensure they adhere to waste disposal legislation and function according to regulations.
*   **Hazardous materials inspector:** Inspects facilities handling hazardous materials to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations and handling legislation.
*   **Occupational health and safety inspector:** Performs workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation.
*   **Environmental mining engineer:** Develops and implements environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts in mining operations.
*   **Airport environment officer:** Monitors emissions and contamination at airports and implements rules for sustainable development.
*   **Natural resources consultant:** Provides advice on the protection and management of natural resources to ensure the conservation of ecosystems.
*   **Recycling specialist:** Supervises waste management and recycling implementation to ensure compliance with regulations.
*   **Environmental policy officer:** Researches and implements policies to reduce the impact of industrial, commercial, and agricultural activities on the environment.
*   **Smart city consultant:** Advises on sustainability solutions for smart city initiatives, including executing environmental projects.
*   **Green ICT consultant:** Advises organisations on green ICT strategies to reach environmental objectives.
*   **Water treatment plant manager:** Ensures a water plant’s operations are compliant with regulations.
*   **Landfill supervisor:** Researches waste management legislation and ensures operations are compliant.
*   **Wastewater treatment operator:** Ensures treated water meets environmental standards.

o.description: Natural resources consultant provide advice on the protection and management of natural resources, namely fauna, flora, soil and water to companies and governments which exploit these resources. They strive to guide companies on an appropriate policy for exploiting natural resources in industrial contexts, raise awareness on health issues, and ensure the conservation of ecosystems for sustainable interventions in natural habitats.

o.label: energy engineer
o.description: Energy engineers design new, efficient and clean ways to produce, transform, and distribute energy to improve environmental sustainability and energy efficiency. They deal with the extraction of energy through natural resources, such as oil or gas, or renewable and sustainable sources, such as wind or solar power.

o.label: policy manager
o.description: Policy managers are responsible for managing the development of policy programs and ensuring that the strategic objectives of the organization are met. They oversee the production of policy positions, as well as the organization's campaign and advocacy work in fields such as environmental, ethics, quality, transparency, and sustainability.

o.label: environmental health inspector
o.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

o.label: industrial waste inspector
o.description: Industrial waste inspectors conduct controls in companies to ensure they comply with waste and environmental regulations. They check the documentation related to waste management, they collect samples for analysis and observe the industrial practices. They may advise or preventive or corrective actions to improve industrial waste management and disposal.

o.label: occupational health and safety inspector
o.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

o.label: airport environment officer
o.description: Airport environment officers monitor environmental issues such as emissions, contamination, and wildlife activity in the premises of airports. They report environmental attractors for animals such as nearby rubbish dumps or wetland areas. They can engage in studying the environmental impact that airports have in the surrounding communities in reference to the diverse contamination that airports produce. They implement the rules to ensure the sustainable development of the airport.

o.label: nature conservation officer
o.description: Nature conservation officers manage and improve the local environment within all the sectors of a local community. They promote awareness of and understanding about the natural environment. This work can be very varied and involve projects related to species, habitats and communities. They educate people and raise overall awareness of environmental issues.

o.label: recycling specialist
o.description: Recycling specialists research recycling policies and legislation, and supervise implementation in an organisation to ensure that waste management occurs according to regulations. They perform inspections, provide recycling equipment, and supervise recycling workers. They also advise organisations on ways they can improve their waste management procedures.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Plant cultivation adviser to the Housekeeping Society Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge
j.description: About the position We are looking for a horticulture advisor for our office in Kalmar. We have an existing customer group on Öland where the majority have animal production with forage farming, therefore it is important that you have good competence in crop rotation and maize. You will have your own customer responsibility for these customers but also work closely with your plant cultivation advisor colleagues at the company. Within Hushållningsällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge, there are also advisers with expertise in construction, agricultural economics, accounting, environment, water and forestry. You will help customers with plant cultivation planning, field advice, EU support and financial follow-up of crops. It also includes writing advisor letters. You are expected to get involved in our customer development and come up with creative ideas on how our services can be developed to meet our customers' needs. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of irrigation of agricultural crops or are knowledgeable in machine costs. About you You need have a strong personal interest in crop cultivation, including cereals, fodder, maize and oilseeds. In order to thrive in this role, you must also have an understanding of the need for cost-effective food production. Important personal qualities are drive, pedagogy and communication. You need to be communicative both with our customers and with your colleagues. It is a strength if you are unprestigious and generous in sharing your experiences and skills. It is also a strength if you are open to testing new ways of working and new innovations in crop cultivation. We place great emphasis on personal qualities. Qualifications We are looking for you who are a qualified soil plant agronomist or farm manager, or equivalent. Alternatively, you who have worked with crop cultivation for a long professional life and have solid experience in this. B driving license is a requirement, as well as very good knowledge of Swedish, both spoken and written. We offer With us you get the opportunity to develop the green industries together with other knowledgeable and committed employees. We specialize in plant cultivation consultancy for agricultural companies. We have an independent role that is appreciated by our clients. We have flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely to a certain extent. We also have a wellness allowance and one wellness hour a week. You get a great opportunity to influence how your working week looks like. At the Housekeeping Society you get the opportunity to develop, your work is characterized by freedom under responsibility while you are involved and contribute to the development of the green sector and a living countryside. Access dates by agreement. The position is a permanent position. Probationary employment of 6 months may be applied. Placement sorter Kalmar. Last application date 2025-01-08. We will process the applications on an ongoing basis. The position may be filled before the application deadline. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.description: 公司描述Syngenta Group is a global leader in agriculture; rooted in science and dedicated to bringing plat potential to life. A core player in the field of agricultural technology and life science innovation, and one of the world's largest agricultural innovation and technology companies, our products and services cover the entire chain of crop protection, seeds, crop nutrition and modern agricultural platforms. With a history dating back more than 250 years, the Group employs nearly 60,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. We work together to solve one of humanity's most pressing challenges: growing more food with fewer resources, supporting the transformation of global agrifood systems through scientific and technological innovation, and improving crop yields and product quality. We rely on green and efficient agricultural inputs and technical solutions to promote sustainable agricultural development and benefit farmers, society and the planet. As one of the four business units of Syngenta Group, Syngenta Group China is committed to becoming the most innovative global ag tech company in China with the mission of bringing modern agriculture to more farmers and consumers. 职位描述Are you passionate about revolutionizing agriculture through cutting-edge science and technology? Syngenta Group China is seeking brilliant minds for our prestigious Scientists Program! We are recruiting high potential young talent from top universities worldwide to build a high-quality research team with strong skills. Designed with a 24-month project cycle for development, we strive to cultivate researchers with global perspectives and innovation drive, preparing expertise needed for future growth. j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

j.title: Technical Sales Representative
j.description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Seeds is one of the world's largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers, and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water, and fewer inputs. Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. j.title: Försöksassistent
j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Plant cultivation adviser to the Housekeeping Society Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge
j.description: About the position We are looking for a horticulture advisor for our office in Kalmar. We have an existing customer group on Öland where the majority have animal production with forage farming, therefore it is important that you have good competence in crop rotation and maize. You will have your own customer responsibility for these customers but also work closely with your plant cultivation advisor colleagues at the company. Within Hushållningsällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge, there are also advisers with expertise in construction, agricultural economics, accounting, environment, water and forestry. You will help customers with plant cultivation planning, field advice, EU support and financial follow-up of crops. It also includes writing advisor letters. You are expected to get involved in our customer development and come up with creative ideas on how our services can be developed to meet our customers' needs. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of irrigation of agricultural crops or are knowledgeable in machine costs. About you You need have a strong personal interest in crop cultivation, including cereals, fodder, maize and oilseeds. In order to thrive in this role, you must also have an understanding of the need for cost-effective food production. Important personal qualities are drive, pedagogy and communication. You need to be communicative both with our customers and with your colleagues. It is a strength if you are unprestigious and generous in sharing your experiences and skills. It is also a strength if you are open to testing new ways of working and new innovations in crop cultivation. We place great emphasis on personal qualities. Qualifications We are looking for you who are a qualified soil plant agronomist or farm manager, or equivalent. Alternatively, you who have worked with crop cultivation for a long professional life and have solid experience in this. B driving license is a requirement, as well as very good knowledge of Swedish, both spoken and written. We offer With us you get the opportunity to develop the green industries together with other knowledgeable and committed employees. We specialize in plant cultivation consultancy for agricultural companies. We have an independent role that is appreciated by our clients. We have flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely to a certain extent. We also have a wellness allowance and one wellness hour a week. You get a great opportunity to influence how your working week looks like. At the Housekeeping Society you get the opportunity to develop, your work is characterized by freedom under responsibility while you are involved and contribute to the development of the green sector and a living countryside. Access dates by agreement. The position is a permanent position. Probationary employment of 6 months may be applied. Placement sorter Kalmar. Last application date 2025-01-08. We will process the applications on an ongoing basis. The position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have questions about the position, please contact: Team Manager, Pernilla Mattsson: pernilla.mattsson@hushallningssallskapet.se, 072-351 50 68 Welcome with your application! Hushållningssällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge Knowledge for the country's future is our promise. We are one of 15 independent Household Associations with the goal of promoting rural development. The household association is an independent, non-profit organization that works for knowledge, research and development of rural green industries and an increased level of supply in Swedish food. We are a member-led organisation, which means that it is the needs of our members that form the backbone of our business. The Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge household management company consists of approx. 230 employees who are spread across six different offices and schools. This allows us to search for skills across a large part of the country and offer work opportunities in three different counties. Please read more about our operations at www.hushallningssallskapet.se Department Counseling Locations Kalmar Remote work Hybrid work Employment form Full-time Application deadline January 8, 2025

j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.description: 公司描述Syngenta Group is a global leader in agriculture; rooted in science and dedicated to bringing plat potential to life. j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

j.description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Seeds is one of the world's largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers, and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water, and fewer inputs. Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. Join us and help shape the future of agriculture.Job DescriptionAt Syngenta, we believe every employee has a role to play in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. To support that challenge, the Vegetable Seeds team is currently seeking a Technical Sales Representative for ScandinaviaWhat will you be doing? Initiates and maintains contact with present and potential customers through field visits and sales calls.Provides a high level of service and product information to customers demonstrating a wide understanding and expertise in the fieldMaintains a high level of communication with the customersDevelops and implements annual trial plans to position new varieties that will meet customer needsProvides technical solutions to difficult problems presented by customers and keeps the Product Specialists informed.Develops and implements sales action plans to achieve annual sales and margin budgetsPosition requires 70-80% regular field visits with the assigned countries (the scope involves the Nordic region; mainly Sweden and Finland)QualificationsB.S. in Agronomy or Horticulture, or equivalent fieldSolid experience in the Vegetable Seed industry is highly preferred with a working knowledge of the Fresh Market and / or Processing market / industryGeneral experience in sales with knowledge of standard sales techniques with the ability to implement new market / business development plans to achieve profitable growth as well as to forecast sales and budgetsMust possess crop management technical skillsMust possess strong written and oral communication skills Ability and willingness to work outdoors in adverse weather conditionsLanguage requirements: full professional proficiency in English and SwedishAdditional InformationWhat we offerExtensive benefits package including a generous pension scheme, bonus scheme, private medical & life insurance. Flexible working options.We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment. Learning culture and wide range of training options. The required skills include:

**Scientific and Research Expertise**
*   **Soil Science:** The study of soil as a natural resource, its characteristics, formation, and classification, as well as its physical, biological, and chemical potential.
*   **Botany:** Knowledge of plant life taxonomy, phylogeny, anatomy, morphology, and physiology.
*   **Genomics:** Researching genomes and genetic sequences to analyze biological functions using bioinformatics and recombinant DNA.
*   **Entomology:** The study of insects.
*   **Life Sciences:** Studying processes related to cells, molecules, and living organisms.
*   **Biological Chemistry:** A medical and scientific specialty related to chemical processes in living organisms.
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to suppressing harmful organisms that minimizes risks to human health and the environment.
*   **Research Improvement of Crop Yields:** Studying production methods to optimize planting, gathering, and cultivation.

j.title: Försöksassistent
j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Plant cultivation adviser to the Housekeeping Society Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge
j.description: About the position We are looking for a horticulture advisor for our office in Kalmar. We have an existing customer group on Öland where the majority have animal production with forage farming, therefore it is important that you have good competence in crop rotation and maize. You will have your own customer responsibility for these customers but also work closely with your plant cultivation advisor colleagues at the company. Within Hushållningsällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge, there are also advisers with expertise in construction, agricultural economics, accounting, environment, water and forestry. You will help customers with plant cultivation planning, field advice, EU support and financial follow-up of crops. It also includes writing advisor letters. You are expected to get involved in our customer development and come up with creative ideas on how our services can be developed to meet our customers' needs. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of irrigation of agricultural crops or are knowledgeable in machine costs. About you You need have a strong personal interest in crop cultivation, including cereals, fodder, maize and oilseeds. In order to thrive in this role, you must also have an understanding of the need for cost-effective food production. Important personal qualities are drive, pedagogy and communication. You need to be communicative both with our customers and with your colleagues. It is a strength if you are unprestigious and generous in sharing your experiences and skills. It is also a strength if you are open to testing new ways of working and new innovations in crop cultivation. We place great emphasis on personal qualities. Qualifications We are looking for you who are a qualified soil plant agronomist or farm manager, or equivalent. Alternatively, you who have worked with crop cultivation for a long professional life and have solid experience in this. B driving license is a requirement, as well as very good knowledge of Swedish, both spoken and written. We offer With us you get the opportunity to develop the green industries together with other knowledgeable and committed employees. We specialize in plant cultivation consultancy for agricultural companies. We have an independent role that is appreciated by our clients. We have flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely to a certain extent. We also have a wellness allowance and one wellness hour a week. You get a great opportunity to influence how your working week looks like. At the Housekeeping Society you get the opportunity to develop, your work is characterized by freedom under responsibility while you are involved and contribute to the development of the green sector and a living countryside. Access dates by agreement. The position is a permanent position. Probationary employment of 6 months may be applied. Placement sorter Kalmar. Last application date 2025-01-08. We will process the applications on an ongoing basis. The position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have questions about the position, please contact: Team Manager, Pernilla Mattsson: pernilla.mattsson@hushallningssallskapet.se, 072-351 50 68 Welcome with your application! Hushållningssällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge Knowledge for the country's future is our promise. We are one of 15 independent Household Associations with the goal of promoting rural development. The household association is an independent, non-profit organization that works for knowledge, research and development of rural green industries and an increased level of supply in Swedish food. We are a member-led organisation, which means that it is the needs of our members that form the backbone of our business. The Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge household management company consists of approx. 230 employees who are spread across six different offices and schools. This allows us to search for skills across a large part of the country and offer work opportunities in three different counties. Please read more about our operations at www.hushallningssallskapet.se Department Counseling Locations Kalmar Remote work Hybrid work Employment form Full-time Application deadline January 8, 2025

j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

j.description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Seeds is one of the world's largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers, and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water, and fewer inputs. Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. Join us and help shape the future of agriculture.Job DescriptionAt Syngenta, we believe every employee has a role to play in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. To support that challenge, the Vegetable Seeds team is currently seeking a Technical Sales Representative for ScandinaviaWhat will you be doing? Initiates and maintains contact with present and potential customers through field visits and sales calls.Provides a high level of service and product information to customers demonstrating a wide understanding and expertise in the fieldMaintains a high level of communication with the customersDevelops and implements annual trial plans to position new varieties that will meet customer needsProvides technical solutions to difficult problems presented by customers and keeps the Product Specialists informed.Develops and implements sales action plans to achieve annual sales and margin budgetsPosition requires 70-80% regular field visits with the assigned countries (the scope involves the Nordic region; mainly Sweden and Finland)QualificationsB.S. in Agronomy or Horticulture, or equivalent fieldSolid experience in the Vegetable Seed industry is highly preferred with a working knowledge of the Fresh Market and / or Processing market / industryGeneral experience in sales with knowledge of standard sales techniques with the ability to implement new market / business development plans to achieve profitable growth as well as to forecast sales and budgetsMust possess crop management technical skillsMust possess strong written and oral communication skills Ability and willingness to work outdoors in adverse weather conditionsLanguage requirements: full professional proficiency in English and SwedishAdditional InformationWhat we offerExtensive benefits package including a generous pension scheme, bonus scheme, private medical & life insurance.
