description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. We ask you to apply for the position through the link in this advertisement to facilitate our handling of incoming applications and to ensure the quality of our selection process. It is of the utmost importance that you are thorough when you fill in your application, as it is assessed against an established skills profile as well as against other applicants. The application for the position is made via our recruitment system. We have actively selected media for advertising and refrain from all offers of advertising and recruitment assistance in connection with this recruitment. The County Administrative Board applies a six-month trial period for this employment. The position may be placed in security class and in in that case, we carry out a security check with a register check in accordance with the provisions of the Security Protection Act before the position is taken up. You will be part of the County Administrative Board's crisis management and war organization. This means that you will be placed at war. You can find information about how we handle your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd.

turns.content: What vacancies exist for professionals who research soil, plants, and animals to improve agricultural processes?

Based on the provided database records, there are several vacancies for professionals involved in research related to soil, plants, and the improvement of agricultural processes. Here are the relevant job opportunities:

*   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding (Job ID: 1924199)**
    *   **Focus:** Research at the Department of Plant Breeding targeting food, feed, and industrial products, specifically focusing on red clover yield and quality improvements.
    *   **Responsibilities:** Hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field, including crossbreeding, phenotyping, comparative genomics, population genetics, and marker-trait association analysis.
    *   **Deadline:** 2025-03-15.

*   **Syngenta Group China Scientist (Job IDs: 184552, 1689159)**
    *   **Focus:** Roles within a global agricultural innovation and technology company. 
    *   **Responsibilities:** Conducting groundbreaking research in seeds, crop protection, crop nutrition, and sustainable agriculture to develop next-generation solutions.
    *   **Qualifications:** PhD in fields including agriculture, plant sciences, plant pathology, bioinformatics, soil science, plant nutrition, agricultural microbiology, or Integrated Pest Management (IPM).

*   **Försöksassistent / Research Assistant (Job ID: 1841619)**
    *   **Focus:** Working at the Lanna research station (part of the Department of Soil and Environment). 
    *   **Responsibilities:** Assisting in plant cultivation experiments, including weighing seed and fertilizer, soil sampling, crop sampling, and measuring gas emissions.
    *   **Requirements:** Interest in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation, education in agriculture preferred, and experience with field equipment.

These positions involve scientific research aimed at improving agricultural production, sustainability, and efficiency.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

turns.content: What does it take to qualify for such a role?

Based on the data retrieved, the skills required for professionals in these research-focused agricultural roles include a mix of scientific expertise, technical competencies, and management capabilities.

The required skills include:

**Scientific and Research Expertise**
*   **Soil Science:** The study of soil as a natural resource, its characteristics, formation, and classification, as well as its physical, biological, and chemical potential.
*   **Botany:** Knowledge of plant life taxonomy, phylogeny, anatomy, morphology, and physiology.
*   **Genomics:** Researching genomes and genetic sequences to analyze biological functions using bioinformatics and recombinant DNA.
*   **Entomology:** The study of insects.
*   **Life Sciences:** Studying processes related to cells, molecules, and living organisms.
*   **Biological Chemistry:** A medical and scientific specialty related to chemical processes in living organisms.
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to suppressing harmful organisms that minimizes risks to human health and the environment.
*   **Research Improvement of Crop Yields:** Studying production methods to optimize planting, gathering, and cultivation.

**Technical and Agricultural Principles**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, growth conditions, and organic/sustainable production requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Conservation Agriculture:** Applying techniques like permanent soil cover, minimum soil disturbance, and plant diversification.
*   **Apply Precision Farming:** Utilizing modern technologies, geo-mapping, and automated steering for agricultural activities.
*   **Agricultural Equipment:** Knowledge of machinery, their functionalities, and regulatory requirements.
*   **E-agriculture:** Applying innovative ICT solutions to agriculture and livestock management.
*   **Bioeconomy:** Converting renewable biological resources into value-added products like food, feed, and bioenergy.

**Management and Analytical Skills**
*   **Ecosystem Management:** Considering the impact of management decisions on the broader ecosystem and optimizing strategies for complex landscapes.
*   **Operational Research:** Applying scientific methods to solve administrative and management issues in organized systems.
*   **Analyse Environmental Data:** Interpreting correlations between human activities and their environmental effects.
*   **Develop Statistical Software:** Participating in the development of computer programs for statistical and econometric analysis.
*   **Energy Efficiency:** Calculating energy consumption and promoting energy-saving or renewable energy strategies.

**Professional Competencies**
*   **Demonstrate Curiosity:** Showing an active interest in exploring and discovering new areas.
*   **Develop Creative Ideas:** Formulating new concepts and innovative approaches.
*   **Communication:** Proficiency in **English**, as well as the ability to provide information on study programs.
*   **General Workplace Duties:** The ability to assign duties to workers, prepare raw materials, label samples, maintain electromechanical equipment, and ensure gender equality in the workplace.

id: 1841619
title: Försöksassistent
description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

id: 1788922
title: Produktionsledare/Driftledare med inriktning dikor och växtodling Svartsjö
description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. For this position, a security screening interview will be conducted before a decision on employment is made. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. In connection with your employment interview, you will receive more information about security clearance. Read more about the security check at: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/Kriminalvården strives for an even gender distribution and increased diversity. Probationary employment may be applied. To submit your application, click on the application link in the advertisement. Ask questions about how to apply and submit your CV directly to Visma Recruit. Questions about specific jobs are answered by the contact person specified in the advertisement. We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies and sellers of recruitment advertisements. The Correctional Service has procured contracts.

id: 1749919
title: Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur
description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. We ask you to apply for the position through the link in this advertisement to facilitate our handling of incoming applications and to ensure the quality of our selection process. It is of the utmost importance that you are thorough when you fill in your application, as it is assessed against an established skills profile as well as against other applicants. The application for the position is made via our recruitment system. We have actively selected media for advertising and refrain from all offers of advertising and recruitment assistance in connection with this recruitment. The County Administrative Board applies a six-month trial period for this employment. The position may be placed in security class and in in that case, we carry out a security check with a register check in accordance with the provisions of the Security Protection Act before the position is taken up. You will be part of the County Administrative Board's crisis management and war organization. This means that you will be placed at war. You can find information about how we handle your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd.
upload_date: 2024-11-28T00:00:00.000000000+00:00

id: 156728
title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se
upload_date: 2024-09-28T00:00:00.000000000+00:00

j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). j.upload_date: 2024-09-05T00:00:00.000000000+00:00"]), Turn(role='user', content='What skills are needed to perform that job successfully?'), Turn(role='assistant', content='To perform the job of a crop production worker successfully, the following skills and competencies are required:

**Core Agricultural & Crop Production Skills:**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Agronomy:** Knowledge of agricultural production, protection, and regeneration of the natural environment, including sustainable application methods.
*   **Soil and Plant Knowledge:** Understanding soil structure, plant species characteristics, and plant propagation methods.
*   **Harvesting & Planting:** Knowledge of plant harvest methods, preparation of planting areas (fertilizing, mulching, sowing), and plant propagation.

**Technical & Maintenance Skills:**
*   **Technical Equipment:** Ability to maintain, service, and adjust machinery used for crop production.
*   **Machinery Operation:** Proficiency in operating motorized equipment such as tractors, balers, sprayers, plows, mowers, and combines.
*   **Irrigation:** Knowledge of watering principles and the ability to irrigate soil using pipes, sprinklers, or ditches, as well as specific techniques like alternate wetting and drying.
*   **Storage Facilities:** Knowledge of storage quality criteria, facility maintenance (temperature/hygiene control), and proper crop storage techniques.

**Pest and Disease Management:**
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to preventing/suppressing harmful organisms while minimizing pesticide use.
*   **Disease & Pest Control:** Identifying and controlling pests and diseases using conventional or biological methods in accordance with safety and environmental regulations.
*   **Modern Technology:** Ability to use pest detection sensors (such as image or acoustic sensors) and agricultural information systems/databases.

**Sustainability & Management:**
*   **Agroecology & Organic Farming:** Applying ecological concepts and principles to production, including organic farming techniques.
*   **Conservation Agriculture:** Applying techniques that minimize soil disturbance and maintain permanent soil cover.
*   **Sustainable Tillage:** Using methods like conservation tillage or no-till farming to reduce soil impact.
*   **Management & Processing:** Ability to assign duties to workers, monitor fields, perform on-farm product processing, and present farm facilities to customers.

**General Practices:**
*   **Fertilization:** Execution of fertilization tasks according to instructions and safety/environmental regulations.
*   **Driving:** Ability to drive tractors and forklifts for transport and field maneuvering.
