j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. **Core Agricultural & Crop Production Skills:**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Agronomy:** Knowledge of agricultural production, protection, and regeneration of the natural environment, including sustainable application methods.
*   **Soil and Plant Knowledge:** Understanding soil structure, plant species characteristics, and plant propagation methods.
*   **Harvesting & Planting:** Knowledge of plant harvest methods, preparation of planting areas (fertilizing, mulching, sowing), and plant propagation.

*   **Technical Equipment:** Ability to maintain, service, and adjust machinery used for crop production.
*   **Machinery Operation:** Proficiency in operating motorized equipment such as tractors, balers, sprayers, plows, mowers, and combines.
*   **Irrigation:** Knowledge of watering principles and the ability to irrigate soil using pipes, sprinklers, or ditches, as well as specific techniques like alternate wetting and drying.

*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to preventing/suppressing harmful organisms while minimizing pesticide use.

j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. turns.content: Are there any openings for a crop production worker?

Yes, there are several openings for roles related to crop production and agricultural work. Based on the provided database, here are the relevant positions:

*   **Versatile agricultural worker (M/F):** Several agencies (such as Aquila RH Blain and Aquila RH Tarbes) are looking for versatile agricultural workers to perform tasks like soil preparation, sowing, crop protection, weeding, harvesting, and machinery maintenance.
*   **Operations manager / Machine operator (Crop cultivation):**
    *   **Åkerö Förvaltning AB:** Looking for an operations manager for 1100 hectares of conventional plant cultivation.
    *   **Östergårds Grönsaker AB:** Seeking machine operators for potato and grain production (Vinslöv).
    *   **SLU Ultuna/Lanna:** Hiring machine operators and an operations manager for crop cultivation and trial operations.
    *   **Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp:** Hiring agricultural operations personnel for their conventional farm and crop cultivation.
*   **Experimental/Field trial positions:**
    *   **Hushållningssällskapet Skåne:** Hiring for plant cultivation attempts/experimental techniques at various locations including Skåne, Borgeby, and Helgegården.
    *   **SLU (Department of Land and Environment / Plant Production Ecology):** Seeking seasonal "Försöksassistent" (experimental assistant) and "Försökstekniker" (experimental technician) for field trials in Lanna and Umeå.
*   **Specialized roles:**
    *   **Lantbruksarbetare för ekologisk odling av indiska grönsaker:** A farm is looking for an agricultural worker specialized in Indian vegetables and organic cultivation.
    *   **Seasonal employee for organic vegetable cultivation (Gotland):** Hiring for sowing, planting, weeding, and harvesting.
    *   **Nursery schoolist (Billbäcks Nursery):** Performing tree cultivation, fertilization, planting, and maintenance.
    *   **Klahammar:** Hiring an employee for a farm focusing on cereals, oil plants, and seeds.
*   **Management and Advisory roles:**
    *   **Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket):** Hiring crop cultivation advisors and administrative roles in plant protection and robust crop cultivation (locations include Skara, Linköping, Jönköping, and Landskrona).
    *   **Växa:** Looking for an Expert in sustainability with a focus on forage and crop cultivation.
    *   **Rijk Zwaan Hellas:** Hiring an agronomist as a Station Manager for horticultural production.

Please note that these positions have different application deadlines and requirements (such as B-driver's licenses, education in agriculture, or specific certifications like sprayer certificates). You may need to review the specific job titles in the provided list to find the contact details or application links for the role that best matches your location and experience.

j.title: Agricultural adviser to the Councilors in Sjuhärad
j.description: Do you want to work with cattle and crop production? Advise on feed for milk and meat production from sowing to feed table? Then this could be something for you! About the service The service is a unique combination of crop cultivation, mainly fodder, and advisory services to farms with milk or meat production. You will be part of working groups with pet advisors and crop advisors. There is also the opportunity to work in various projects connected to agriculture. About you We are looking for you who are agronomists, land managers or have equivalent education. You must have experience in both crop cultivation and cattle. You need to enjoy having customer contact and like working in a team. Great emphasis is placed on personal suitability. We offer We have a wide range of activities in economics, crop cultivation, forestry and animal production. The advisers also have a department with pet technicians who perform farm-related services and are based in Ulricehamn. We have a close collaboration with the Housekeeping Society Sjuhärad, where research is conducted and experimental activities and training through the Strömma Naturbrukcentrum. The head office is at the Rural Advisory Center in Länghem, a few miles from Borås. We offer a fantastic work environment with committed colleagues and short decision-making paths. Qualifications You need to have a driver's license and access to a car and be trained as an agronomist, land master or equivalent. Welcome with your application!

j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Vi söker växtodlingsrådgivare till växtskyddscentralen i Landskrona
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. turns.content: What skills are needed to perform that job successfully?

To perform the job of a crop production worker successfully, the following skills and competencies are required:

**Core Agricultural & Crop Production Skills:**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Agronomy:** Knowledge of agricultural production, protection, and regeneration of the natural environment, including sustainable application methods.
*   **Soil and Plant Knowledge:** Understanding soil structure, plant species characteristics, and plant propagation methods.
*   **Harvesting & Planting:** Knowledge of plant harvest methods, preparation of planting areas (fertilizing, mulching, sowing), and plant propagation.

**Technical & Maintenance Skills:**
*   **Technical Equipment:** Ability to maintain, service, and adjust machinery used for crop production.
*   **Machinery Operation:** Proficiency in operating motorized equipment such as tractors, balers, sprayers, plows, mowers, and combines.
*   **Irrigation:** Knowledge of watering principles and the ability to irrigate soil using pipes, sprinklers, or ditches, as well as specific techniques like alternate wetting and drying.
*   **Storage Facilities:** Knowledge of storage quality criteria, facility maintenance (temperature/hygiene control), and proper crop storage techniques.

**Pest and Disease Management:**
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to preventing/suppressing harmful organisms while minimizing pesticide use.
*   **Disease & Pest Control:** Identifying and controlling pests and diseases using conventional or biological methods in accordance with safety and environmental regulations.
*   **Modern Technology:** Ability to use pest detection sensors (such as image or acoustic sensors) and agricultural information systems/databases.

**Sustainability & Management:**
*   **Agroecology & Organic Farming:** Applying ecological concepts and principles to production, including organic farming techniques.
*   **Conservation Agriculture:** Applying techniques that minimize soil disturbance and maintain permanent soil cover.
*   **Sustainable Tillage:** Using methods like conservation tillage or no-till farming to reduce soil impact.
*   **Management & Processing:** Ability to assign duties to workers, monitor fields, perform on-farm product processing, and present farm facilities to customers.

**General Practices:**
*   **Fertilization:** Execution of fertilization tasks according to instructions and safety/environmental regulations.
*   **Driving:** Ability to drive tractors and forklifts for transport and field maneuvering.
*   **Monitoring:** Assessing crops for growth forecasts and weather-related damage.

skill_label: quality criteria for storage facilities
skill_description: Quality criteria for storage facilities such as safe locking systems, ventilation, regularly inspected fireproofing systems, etc.

skill_label: agroecology
skill_description: The study and application of ecological and agronomic concepts and principles to agricultural production systems.

skill_label: conservation agriculture
skill_description: The techniques, methods and principles that promote a sustainable use of land and soil in crop production. It is based on the three principles of permanent soil cover, minimum soil disturbance, and diversification of plant species.

skill_label: technical equipment for crop production
skill_description: Methods for service, maintaining and adjusting of technical equipment, machines and instatallations used for crop production.

skill_label: watering principles
skill_description: Methods, principles and systems for supplying water to land or crops by means of pipes, sprinklers, ditches or streams.

skill_label: assign duties to agriculture workers
skill_description: Assign duties, such as the cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting of crops or plants. Supervise product packaging or grading and equipment maintenance.

skill_label: preserve crop
skill_description: Assess the quality of the crop taking into account the preserving and storing conditions and criteria.

skill_label: integrated pest management
skill_description: An integrated approach to the prevention and/or suppression of organisms harmful to plants that aims to keep the use of pesticides and other forms of intervention only to levels that are economically and ecologically justified and which reduce or minimise risks for the human health and the environment.

skill_label: pest control in plants
skill_description: Types and features of pests in plants and crops. Different kinds of pest control methods, activities using conventional or biological methods taking into account the type of plant or crop, environmental and climate conditions and health and safety regulations. Storage and handling of products.

skill_label: hydroponics
skill_description: The cultivation of plants without the use of soil, by applying mineral nutrient solutions.

skill_label: plant disease control
skill_description: Types and features of diseases in plants and crops. Different kinds control methods, activities using conventional or biological methods taking into account the type of plant or crop, environmental and climate conditions and health and safety regulations. Storage and handling of products.

skill_label: perform on-farm product processing
skill_description: Transform the primary farm product by tools and/or machinery into elaborated food products, respecting the quality objectives, hygiene and security legislation or rules.

skill_label: use agricultural information systems and databases
skill_description: Use relevant information systems and databases to plan, manage and operate agricultural enterprise and production.

skill_label: agronomy
skill_description: The study of combining agriculture production and protection and regeneration of natural environment. It includes the principles and methods of critical selection and adequate application methods for sustainability in agriculture.

skill_label: soil structure
skill_description: Diversity of soil elements and types of soil in relation to plant growth.

skill_label: plant species

turns.content: Which other occupations require practical agronomical crop production experience?

Although there is no information exactly related to your query about specific job openings, I can provide you with the list of occupations from the database that share the skill of agronomical crop production.

The following occupations involve practical involvement in the production process and may require experience in the field:

*   **Agronomic crop production team leader:** Responsible for leading a team of workers, organizing daily work schedules for crop production, and participating in the production process.
*   **Crop production manager:** Responsible for planning production, managing the enterprise, and actively participating in the production process of crop production facilities.
*   **Farm manager:** Responsible for planning and organizing the daily operations, resourcing, and business management of farms producing crops and animals.
*   **Mixed farmer:** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production, either as a small enterprise or for self-sufficiency.
*   **Horticulture production team leader:** Leads a team and organizes daily work schedules specifically for the production of horticulture crops, while also participating in production.
*   **Horticulture production manager:** Plans the production, manages the enterprise, and participates in horticultural production.
*   **Agricultural inspector:** Monitors and inspects agricultural operations, including production processes, to ensure compliance with legislation and standards.
*   **Agriculture, forestry and fishery vocational teacher:** Instructs students in practical skills and techniques required for professions in these fields.
*   **Soil scientist:** Studies soil science and advises on improving soil quality for food production, including the use of irrigation and erosion reduction measures. 

Please note that these roles vary in their level of management and specialized focus, but all are linked to the agricultural production sector.

j.upload_date: 2024-11-27T00:00:00.000000000+00:00', "j.title: Maskinförare växtodling
j.description: We are looking for a machine operator in agriculture for the crop growing season 2025. As part of our team at Ultuna property, you will work on an agricultural farm at the forefront with close proximity to research, trials and students. About the job You are offered a varied job with great personal responsibility and many contact areas and development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. With us, you will perform, among other things, tillage, transport, inspection of crops, machine work and more. You will work in our regular team, which consists of the operations manager, a farm manager and two machine operators. Together with them, you are responsible for tending and salvaging this year's grain harvest. To help you, you have a modern fleet of machines that you also look after and maintain. The job is seasonal employment according to agreement during the period June-September 2025. Certain overtime work on weekends and evenings may occur. Your background We are looking for you who have a great interest in agriculture, experience as a machine operator in crop cultivation and driver's license B. Driver's license for a loading machine and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L are meritorious. We will place great emphasis on personal suitability. About us On the Ultuna property, we usually have around 1300 crops and pasture. The plant cultivation is both conventional and organic and approx. 90-140 hectares are plant cultivation trials or trial farms. More information about the Ultuna estate can be found here: https://internt.slu.se/Organisation-och-styrning/organisation/gemensamma-verkehmstodet/egendomsavdelningen/ultuna -property/Ultuna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu /jobba-pa-slu/Location: SLU Ultuna Egendom, Funbo Lövsta 70, Uppsala. Form of employment: Seasonal employment, crop growing season 2025 Scope: 100% Admission: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-02-03. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, grounded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: For Framtidsgården Bjertorp, we are now looking for you with a great interest in the agriculture of the future and who wants to work in an engaging and happy team with a fast pace during the season 2025. Bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruk's Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We run a modern and rational agriculture on 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens Egendom, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and the development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition to this, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The trial operation covers approximately 20 hectares and 6,000 trial plots which are distributed over the farm's area. The position is a seasonal position for the 2025 season, starting April 1 and running until October 31. There is the possibility of extension, and access is by agreement. This is what you will do. Together with other staff, you will primarily manage the operations to be carried out on a crop farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and fodder harvesting in Viken. You will also help with the sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loader driving and machine maintenance occurs. All work in the field is carried out with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest machine technology to ensure high efficiency, precision and durability. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have: An agricultural education (or several years of experience in the profession) Experience of driving machinery and a great interest in agriculture B driver's license Good knowledge of the Swedish language You are: Responsible and thorough in your work A team player who can cooperate with others in your environment, but who can also work independently Spraying certificate is a merit You shares our values ​​Openness, Holistic view and Action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you will have the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment takes place according to agreement, with a desirable start date from 1 April to 31 October. There is the possibility of an extension. The location of the position is Kvänum, where you will report to the operations manager. If necessary, housing is available. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28, 2025. Selection takes place continuously. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com. j.upload_date: 2024-10-15T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", "j.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
j.description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. More information about the institution/department: https://internal. sly see/Organisation-och-styrningen/organisation/gemensamma-verkehsamstodet/egendomsavdelningen/lantbruksdriften/Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www. sly se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Lanna research station, Saleby, Lidköping Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment. Scope: 100% Access: By agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 12/16/2024. Union contact persons: https://internal. sly see/my-anstalling/union/contacts/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

j.upload_date: 2025-01-09T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", 'j.title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together.
