description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

### **Management and Operational Leadership**
*   **Assign duties to agriculture workers:** Supervise product packaging, grading, and equipment maintenance, and assign cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting tasks.
*   **Organise labour:** Manage production programs, sales, stocks, and the purchasing of materials and equipment.
*   **Evaluate employees' work:** Assess labor needs, evaluate team performance, and support/teach employees to ensure productivity and quality.
*   **Supervise staff:** Oversee staff selection, training, motivation, and performance.
*   **Apply organisational techniques:** Use detailed planning for personnel schedules and manage resources efficiently and sustainably.
*   **Programme work according to incoming orders:** Assess required working hours, workforce, and equipment to complete scheduled tasks.
*   **Monitor work site:** Ensure working conditions meet health and safety requirements and do not pose threats to others.

### **Machinery and Technical Skills**
*   **Operate agricultural machinery:** Operate tractors, balers, sprayers, ploughs, mowers, combines, earthmoving equipment, trucks, and irrigation equipment.
*   **Maintain technical equipment:** Maintain inventories of equipment and supplies and order materials as needed.
*   **Supervise equipment:** Identify and troubleshoot technical problems, conduct minor repairs, and monitor equipment for safety and environmental hazards.
*   **Operate landscaping equipment:** Use a variety of tools such as chain saws, tillers, backhoes, and sprayers.
*   **Operate forestry machinery:** Operate machinery for harvesting, forwarding, and transporting wood.
*   **Principles of mechanical engineering:** Understand the principles of physics, materials science, and mechanical engineering.
*   **Operate GPS systems:** Proficiency in using GPS technology.

### **Field and Crop Management**
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Determine the need and timing for sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mow, pick, or cut products using appropriate tools and machinery according to quality and hygiene standards.
*   **Pest control in plants:** Apply conventional or biological pest control methods while adhering to health and safety regulations.
*   **Handling chemical products for soil and plants:** Prepare fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides, and clean equipment used for spraying or spreading.
*   **Create soil and plant improvement programmes:** Develop and advise on soil health and plant nutrition programs.
*   **Crop production principles:** Understand the natural cycle, growth conditions, and principles of sustainable/organic production.
*   **Variety of botanicals:** Principles focused on herbaceous and annual plants in raw form.
*   **Soil structure:** Understand the diversity of soil elements and their relation to plant growth.
*   **Agronomy:** Combine agricultural production with the protection and regeneration of the natural environment.

### **Administrative and Business Skills**

*   **Road traffic laws:** Understand national traffic codes and rules governing the circulation of vehicles.

description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Natural Resources Administration is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here, we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to search for. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. DescriptionWith us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, lack of prestige and a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the work team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machines and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out in agriculture to learn the craft of becoming the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent knowledge Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license engine clearing chainsaw Experience of digitization in agriculture such as auto steering etc. We attach great importance to personal suitability. Terms and conditions The position is a permanent position with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Entry in February 2025 or by agreement. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We make sure there is good healthcare for all. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region is actively working to digitize more working methods. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk aware and have motivation to participate in development to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region is placing all permanently employed employees at war. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https://www. vgregion. see/introduction. You can also read more in the presentation on https://mellanarkiv-offentlig. vgregion. see/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate. upload_date: 2024-12-12T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", "title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Naturbruksförvaltningen is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to apply to. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. Description With us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, non-prestige and have a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machinery and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out into agriculture to learn the craft to become the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent skills Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license motor- clearing chainsawExperience of digitization in agriculture such as auto control, etc. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. Conditions The employment is a temporary position during the period February-November 2025 which may be extended with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure that there is good healthcare for everyone. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region works actively to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk-aware and have motivation to participate in development in order to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region hires all permanent employees. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https: //www.vgregion.se/introduktion.  You can also read more in the presentation about https://mellanarkiv-offentlig.vgregion.se/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate.ApplicationVästra Götalandregionen prefers that you register your application via the recruitment system. If you, as an applicant, have questions about the advertised position or for special and special reasons cannot register your data in a public system - contact the contact person for the respective advertisement. To staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies and to you who are sellers: We refrain from friendly but firm direct contact with staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies as well as other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. The Västra Götaland region has procured agreements.

description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

### **Management and Operational Leadership**
*   **Assign duties to agriculture workers:** Supervise product packaging, grading, and equipment maintenance, and assign cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting tasks.
*   **Organise labour:** Manage production programs, sales, stocks, and the purchasing of materials and equipment.
*   **Evaluate employees' work:** Assess labor needs, evaluate team performance, and support/teach employees to ensure productivity and quality.
*   **Supervise staff:** Oversee staff selection, training, motivation, and performance.
*   **Apply organisational techniques:** Use detailed planning for personnel schedules and manage resources efficiently and sustainably.
*   **Programme work according to incoming orders:** Assess required working hours, workforce, and equipment to complete scheduled tasks.
*   **Monitor work site:** Ensure working conditions meet health and safety requirements and do not pose threats to others.

### **Machinery and Technical Skills**
*   **Operate agricultural machinery:** Operate tractors, balers, sprayers, ploughs, mowers, combines, earthmoving equipment, trucks, and irrigation equipment.
*   **Maintain technical equipment:** Maintain inventories of equipment and supplies and order materials as needed.
*   **Supervise equipment:** Identify and troubleshoot technical problems, conduct minor repairs, and monitor equipment for safety and environmental hazards.
*   **Operate landscaping equipment:** Use a variety of tools such as chain saws, tillers, backhoes, and sprayers.
*   **Operate forestry machinery:** Operate machinery for harvesting, forwarding, and transporting wood.
*   **Principles of mechanical engineering:** Understand the principles of physics, materials science, and mechanical engineering.
*   **Operate GPS systems:** Proficiency in using GPS technology.

### **Field and Crop Management**
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Determine the need and timing for sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mow, pick, or cut products using appropriate tools and machinery according to quality and hygiene standards.
*   **Pest control in plants:** Apply conventional or biological pest control methods while adhering to health and safety regulations.
*   **Handling chemical products for soil and plants:** Prepare fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides, and clean equipment used for spraying or spreading.

*   **Variety of botanicals:** Principles focused on herbaceous and annual plants in raw form.
*   **Soil structure:** Understand the diversity of soil elements and their relation to plant growth.
*   **Agronomy:** Combine agricultural production with the protection and regeneration of the natural environment.

            "title: F\u00f6rs\u00f6kstekniker till Sandbyg\u00e5rd\ndescription: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. Welcome to us at Hush\u00e5llningss\u00e4llskapet Sk\u00e5ne!Hush\u00e5llningss\u00e4llskapet Sk\u00e5ne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. turns.content: Are there any job opportunities for a land-based machinery supervisor?

Based on the provided information, there are no job listings explicitly titled "land-based machinery supervisor." However, there are positions focused on the supervision and management of agricultural machinery and field operations.

The following roles are currently available:

*   **Foreman, Agricultural machinery (Swedish Agro, Skara):** This role involves leading and distributing work in the workshop and in the field, supporting the technical team of 10 technicians, administering work orders, and managing machine logistics. It requires technical interest, knowledge of heavy machinery, and experience in the agricultural/machinery industry.
*   **Cultivation Manager (near Amiens):** This role acts as the "right arm of the production manager" and includes the supervision of a team of 4 employees, managing agricultural sites, and overseeing the operation and maintenance of the agricultural machinery fleet (John Deere equipment).
*   **Agricultural operations personnel (Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp):** This position involves planning and carrying out tasks regarding crop cultivation and machinery. It requires "Master farmer" or "agrotechnician" level skills and solid professional experience in agriculture.

If these roles are of interest, you may want to review the specific duties mentioned in the database to see which best aligns with your experience as a machinery supervisor.

title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Natural Resources Administration is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here, we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to search for. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. DescriptionWith us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, lack of prestige and a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the work team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machines and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out in agriculture to learn the craft of becoming the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent knowledge Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license engine clearing chainsaw Experience of digitization in agriculture such as auto steering etc. We attach great importance to personal suitability. Terms and conditions The position is a permanent position with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Entry in February 2025 or by agreement. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We make sure there is good healthcare for all. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region is actively working to digitize more working methods. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk aware and have motivation to participate in development to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region is placing all permanently employed employees at war. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https://www. vgregion. see/introduction. You can also read more in the presentation on https://mellanarkiv-offentlig. vgregion. see/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate. Application The Västra Götaland region prefers that you register your application via the recruitment system. If you, as an applicant, have questions about the advertised position or for special and special reasons cannot register your data in a public system - contact the contact person for the respective advertisement. To staffing, agency and recruitment companies and to you who are sellers: We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing, agency and recruitment companies as well as other external actors and sellers of further job advertisements. The Västra Götaland region has procured agreements.

title: Försökstekniker till Sandbygård
description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. turns.content: What competences are necessary for that profession?

Based on the information retrieved, the following competences are essential for a professional in an agricultural or land-based machinery supervision role:

### **Management and Operational Leadership**
*   **Assign duties to agriculture workers:** Supervise product packaging, grading, and equipment maintenance, and assign cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting tasks.
*   **Organise labour:** Manage production programs, sales, stocks, and the purchasing of materials and equipment.
*   **Evaluate employees' work:** Assess labor needs, evaluate team performance, and support/teach employees to ensure productivity and quality.
*   **Supervise staff:** Oversee staff selection, training, motivation, and performance.
*   **Apply organisational techniques:** Use detailed planning for personnel schedules and manage resources efficiently and sustainably.
*   **Programme work according to incoming orders:** Assess required working hours, workforce, and equipment to complete scheduled tasks.
*   **Monitor work site:** Ensure working conditions meet health and safety requirements and do not pose threats to others.

### **Machinery and Technical Skills**
*   **Operate agricultural machinery:** Operate tractors, balers, sprayers, ploughs, mowers, combines, earthmoving equipment, trucks, and irrigation equipment.
*   **Maintain technical equipment:** Maintain inventories of equipment and supplies and order materials as needed.
*   **Supervise equipment:** Identify and troubleshoot technical problems, conduct minor repairs, and monitor equipment for safety and environmental hazards.
*   **Operate landscaping equipment:** Use a variety of tools such as chain saws, tillers, backhoes, and sprayers.
*   **Operate forestry machinery:** Operate machinery for harvesting, forwarding, and transporting wood.
*   **Principles of mechanical engineering:** Understand the principles of physics, materials science, and mechanical engineering.
*   **Operate GPS systems:** Proficiency in using GPS technology.

### **Field and Crop Management**
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Determine the need and timing for sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mow, pick, or cut products using appropriate tools and machinery according to quality and hygiene standards.
*   **Pest control in plants:** Apply conventional or biological pest control methods while adhering to health and safety regulations.
*   **Handling chemical products for soil and plants:** Prepare fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides, and clean equipment used for spraying or spreading.
*   **Create soil and plant improvement programmes:** Develop and advise on soil health and plant nutrition programs.
*   **Crop production principles:** Understand the natural cycle, growth conditions, and principles of sustainable/organic production.
*   **Variety of botanicals:** Principles focused on herbaceous and annual plants in raw form.
*   **Soil structure:** Understand the diversity of soil elements and their relation to plant growth.
*   **Agronomy:** Combine agricultural production with the protection and regeneration of the natural environment.

### **Administrative and Business Skills**
*   **Budgetary principles:** Estimate and plan forecasts for business activity and compile reports.
*   **Write work-related reports:** Document information and present results in a clear way for both expert and non-expert audiences.
*   **Propose ICT solutions to business problems:** Suggest ICT means to improve business processes.
*   **Advise client on technical possibilities:** Recommend technical solutions within project frameworks.
*   **Road traffic laws:** Understand national traffic codes and rules governing the circulation of vehicles.
*   **Work in a land-based team:** Collaborate with others regarding services for agricultural production and landscaping.
*   **Perform park safety inspections:** Note and report risks or problems in park areas.

JobTitle: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. JobTitle: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

While none of the job titles are exclusively "Agricultural Machinery Planner," the following positions involve significant responsibilities for planning, coordinating, or maintaining agricultural machinery services:

    *   **Upload Date:** 2025-01-08

    *   **Description:** Responsible for harvest logistics, coordinating seed potato logistics, and managing control of external contract goods.

Occupation: horticulture production manager
JobTitle: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

turns.content: What skills would I need to obtain one of these positions?

To obtain a position as a **Plant engineering consultant**, **Maskinförare växtodling**, **Agraringenieur/ Anbauberater**, **Tractor and machine operator**, or **Agricultural Technician M/F**, you would need the following skills, as identified in the database:

### Technical & Mechanical Skills
*   **Maintain agricultural machinery:** Ability to maintain agricultural facilities and equipment to ensure they are clean and in safe, working order, including performing routine maintenance and repairs.
*   **Maintain mechanical equipment:** Competence in observing and listening to machinery to detect malfunctions, and servicing/repairing vehicles used for farming.
*   **Agricultural equipment:** Knowledge of agricultural machinery and equipment products, their functionalities, properties, and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

### Crop & Field Management Skills
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Skill in inspecting crops, fields, and plant stock to determine the need and timing for tasks like sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Manage crop rotation:** Planning and performing crop rotation and management techniques to optimize soil nutrients, improve fertility, and combat weed/pest pressure.
*   **Crop production principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and principles of organic and sustainable production.
*   **Preserve crop:** Assessing crop quality while considering storage conditions and preservation criteria.

### Operations & Management Skills
*   **Operations management:** Applying backend business functions to achieve high efficiency and profitability.
*   **Manage farm products:** Making contracts with customers and business partners to ensure optimal production based on farm plans.
*   **Manage consumables stock:** Monitoring consumables to ensure production demands and deadlines are met.
*   **Mathematical economics:** Using mathematical principles to construct models for economic theory.
*   **Operational research:** Applying scientific methods to provide solutions to administrative and management issues.
*   **Ecosystem management:** Managing decision-making effects on ecosystem elements and optimizing strategies for fragmented landscapes.

### General & Professional Skills
*   **Perform office routine activities:** Handling daily office tasks such as mailing, receiving supplies, and updating staff to keep operations running smoothly.
*   **Promote social security programmes:** Promoting government aid programs for individuals.
*   **Perform lectures:** Presenting lectures to various groups.
*   **Teach geoscience:** Instructing students in the theory and practice of earth sciences (e.g., geology, meteorology).
*   **Promote animal welfare:** Working with compassion to sustain high standards of animal welfare.
*   **Develop creative ideas:** Developing new concepts.
*   **Organise cultural events:** Arranging events to promote local culture and heritage.
*   **Recreation activities:** Understanding the characteristics of recreational activities for customers.

turns.content: Are there any related occupations that also require client coordination and operational planning?

Although there is no information exactly related to the specific agricultural machinery planning roles previously discussed, I have information from the database regarding occupations that involve high levels of operational planning, coordination, and management—tasks often critical to overseeing production and infrastructure.

The following occupations retrieved from the database involve significant responsibilities in **operational planning, scheduling, staff coordination, and meeting production/client goals**:

*   **Production supervisor:** Responsible for coordinating, planning, and directing manufacturing and production processes, including reviewing production schedules and managing staff.
*   **Industrial maintenance supervisor:** Organises and supervises maintenance operations for systems and equipment to ensure productivity and quality requirements are met.
*   **Power distribution engineer:** Designs and operates power distribution facilities, researches methods for the optimisation of distribution, and ensures consumer needs are met.
*   **Strategic planning manager:** Creates and provides coordination for the implementation of strategic plans across departments to ensure consistency in business execution.
*   **Chief operating officer:** Ensures the daily operations of a company run smoothly, including the development of company policies, rules, and long-term goals.
*   **Vessel assembly supervisor / Aircraft assembly supervisor / Motor vehicle assembly supervisor:** These roles coordinate employees, schedule activities, prepare production reports, oversee supplies, and communicate with other departments to avoid interruptions in the production process.
*   **Sport facility manager:** Leads and manages the operations, programming, and staffing of a facility to ensure it provides excellent service while achieving financial and operational targets.

These roles share the common themes of managing workflows, overseeing resource allocation, and ensuring that operational processes meet the required standards for efficiency and client service.

job_description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt

description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. These are categorized into practical skills and theoretical knowledge:

### **Animal Care and Management Competencies**
*   **Livestock Health & Welfare:** Managing the health and welfare of livestock, including assessing health status, creating welfare plans, controlling diseases and parasites (using vaccination/medication), and isolating sick animals.
*   **Breeding:** Breeding and raising various livestock (cattle, poultry, goats, rabbits, ducks, ostriches, snails, and honeybees), assisting with animal births, and caring for newborns.
*   **Feeding:** Providing animal nutrition, using computerized feeding systems, and maintaining pastures (rotation and conservation).
*   **Specific Husbandry Tasks:** Milking animals, performing milk control, slaughtering animals, skinning animals, managing livestock manure, and specialized procedures for pigs (branding, tagging, castration, tail-docking, and tooth cutting).
*   **Handling Specific Species:** Training horses and conducting the shearing of wool.

### **Production and Farm Operations**
*   **Crop and Resource Management:** Managing crop production (planning, tilling, planting, fertilizing, harvesting), monitoring crops for disease, installing irrigation systems, and managing grain storage.
*   **Facility Maintenance:** Operating and maintaining farm equipment, managing farm supplies (purchasing and storing), and cleaning/sanitizing farm facilities and equipment (including milking hygiene).
*   **Product Processing:** Processing dairy products, harvesting/processing honey, and handling feathers.
*   **Agritourism:** Presenting farm facilities to visitors and organizing agritourism activities.

### **Required Knowledge Areas**
*   **Animal Nutrition:** Understanding different species' dietary needs, water requirements, and quality criteria for feed.
*   **Biology:** Knowledge of tissues, cells, and the interactions of organisms with the environment.
*   **Agronomical Principles:** Understanding conventional agronomical production techniques.
*   **Equine Care:** Specifically regarding equine dental diseases (prevention, diagnosis, and treatment).
*   **Technical Systems:** Knowledge of computerized feeding systems.
*   **Agritourism:** Understanding the principles of agricultural activities for visitors.

### **General and Administrative Skills**
*   **Operations:** Ordering supplies, storing raw food materials, and maintaining linen operations.
*   **Service:** Serving food in a table service setting and arranging tables for events.

turns.content: Are there any openings for a livestock worker?

Based on the information provided by the database for the occupation related to livestock and animal care, there are several relevant job openings:

*   **Animal care employee or animal care assistant (f/m/d)**: A position focused on the well-being of farm animals, requiring a qualification as an animal care worker or comparable experience. It involves working in a multi-professional team and requires willingness to work on weekends and public holidays.
*   **Poultry worker (M/F)**: Several vacancies available in the livestock and hatchery sectors. Duties include interacting with live animals, providing care, daily egg collection, and monitoring animal health and well-being.
*   **Produktionsledare/Driftledare med inriktning dikor och växtodling (Production manager/Operations manager with a focus on suckler cows and crop cultivation)**: A role primarily responsible for the animals (specifically a Hereford breeding herd) along with colleagues, and guiding inmates in their daily work.
*   **Versatile agricultural worker - Animal worker (M/F)**: Positions involving the preparation and distribution of feed, cleaning and disinfecting livestock facilities, monitoring animals, and maintaining farm buildings. Experience in animal breeding is sought for these roles.

Additionally, there are related administrative and advisory roles that require experience with livestock:

*   **Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals**: A role focused on skills development for farmers, including counseling and courses regarding farm animal husbandry.
*   **Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur (Animal welfare officer with a focus on farm animals)**: A role focused on animal welfare control of farm animals, including routine checks and follow-ups.
*   **Växtodlingsrådgivare (Crop cultivation advisor)**: While focused on crop cultivation, this role also encompasses competence in farm animals and animal production.

turns.content: What does it take to work in that occupation?

Based on the database, working in this occupation requires a comprehensive set of skills, competencies, and knowledge areas. These are categorized into practical skills and theoretical knowledge:

### **Animal Care and Management Competencies**
*   **Livestock Health & Welfare:** Managing the health and welfare of livestock, including assessing health status, creating welfare plans, controlling diseases and parasites (using vaccination/medication), and isolating sick animals.
*   **Breeding:** Breeding and raising various livestock (cattle, poultry, goats, rabbits, ducks, ostriches, snails, and honeybees), assisting with animal births, and caring for newborns.
*   **Feeding:** Providing animal nutrition, using computerized feeding systems, and maintaining pastures (rotation and conservation).
*   **Specific Husbandry Tasks:** Milking animals, performing milk control, slaughtering animals, skinning animals, managing livestock manure, and specialized procedures for pigs (branding, tagging, castration, tail-docking, and tooth cutting).
*   **Handling Specific Species:** Training horses and conducting the shearing of wool.

### **Production and Farm Operations**
*   **Crop and Resource Management:** Managing crop production (planning, tilling, planting, fertilizing, harvesting), monitoring crops for disease, installing irrigation systems, and managing grain storage.
*   **Facility Maintenance:** Operating and maintaining farm equipment, managing farm supplies (purchasing and storing), and cleaning/sanitizing farm facilities and equipment (including milking hygiene).
*   **Product Processing:** Processing dairy products, harvesting/processing honey, and handling feathers.
*   **Agritourism:** Presenting farm facilities to visitors and organizing agritourism activities.

### **Required Knowledge Areas**
*   **Animal Nutrition:** Understanding different species' dietary needs, water requirements, and quality criteria for feed.
*   **Biology:** Knowledge of tissues, cells, and the interactions of organisms with the environment.
*   **Agronomical Principles:** Understanding conventional agronomical production techniques.
*   **Equine Care:** Specifically regarding equine dental diseases (prevention, diagnosis, and treatment).
*   **Technical Systems:** Knowledge of computerized feeding systems.

turns.content: Which other occupations require expertise in animal health and welfare?

Although there is no information exactly related to the original question about specific "openings," the database contains the following occupations that require expertise in animal health and welfare:

*   **Agricultural inspector**: Monitors agricultural operations, including health and safety measures, and ensures that activities comply with legislation and standards.

*   **Aquatic animal health professional**: Diagnoses, prevents, and treats diseases, injuries, and dysfunctions of aquatic animals; supervises the use of medicines and vaccines; and advises farm staff on best practices for animal health and welfare.
*   **Zoology technician**: Provides technical assistance in researching and testing animal species and aids in research concerning animals and their ecosystems.
*   **General veterinarian**: Works in the interest of the health and welfare of animals and public health, with the authority to carry out all aspects of veterinary medicine for various species.

j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production?
