Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. j.description: All data about cattle together with advisory services and digital tools is what we call Kokontrollen. The cow control helps our customers see the whole of their production and provides access to accurate reports, standardized sample milking, analyzes and industry comparisons. In the Cow Control & KAP department, we also work with pedigree control, whose data facilitates the customers' breeding planning and provides official pedigrees. Do you also want to be involved in developing Sweden's milk and beef production? In the position with us you will: Be a part of our Cow Control expert group and work with questions about Cow Control and KAP Have lots of customer contacts, mainly via phone and email but also visits. Assist our existing and new customers with questions regarding cow control, KAP, lineage control and our management system MinGård incl. associated functions Have good opportunities to contribute to the department's and Väx's future development based on your own interests and skills Depending on your background and your interests work with other issues, e.g. meat, pedigree verification, helping customers get started with test milking or the like. Appropriate education and experience We want that you have knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector. Maybe you have worked on a farm, as an advisor, service technician or something else. It is also advantageous if you have knowledge of e.g. meat, studbook/lineage or technical systems on farms, e.g. robotic milking or other farm systems. If you also have relevant training in animal science, farm manager or similar, it is a plus but not a requirement. As a person, you are meticulous and proactive, and talking to customers should feel easy and fun for you. You enjoy a job that contains a mixture of creative innovation and some tasks of a more routine nature. You find it easy to see opportunities, create good relationships and collaborate. We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive, great commitment and ability to meet people. j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. The work tasks involve daily care of cows, small calves and sheep in small -scale and small -scale old -fashioned operations. Cleaning and repair/maintenance of animal stables and keeping cows clean. Feeding, cleaning, fingering, feeding, in the case of cows and sheep, and sheep. Preparation of fencing (sheep and predator fencing) in 3 different grazing areas. Cleaning under electrical threads. Equestrian and cleaning wiping house. Care and maintenance of the farm's machines. (Buster Volvo BM + MF 85hp with tools sombal machines, wrappers, drag gear, chainsaw, cleaning saw, etc.) Responsible for hay harvest of about 12 hectares, be able to handle and possibly cook our bal machine, hay bales and handling traktor gear. Potatoes by hand. Maintenance and painting with linseed oil paint on the farm's barns, buildings and property. Funny carpentry with a focus on building maintenance. Keep careful order on all the farm's tools for tools and order in the farm's little carpentry. Be in its place but still be effective in the work. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: About usYou don't know us yet? We are the specialist authority in Saxony responsible for the environment, nature conservation, agriculture, geology and rural development. In these areas, we particularly carry out non-profit tasks such as advice, applied research, funding, control, reporting and documentation. Department 78 "Teaching and Experimental Material" fulfills tasks in the area of ​​vocational training and further education, as a test base within the LfULG and in the demonstration of sustainable agriculture. Focus of in-company training Calf and young cattle rearing Cattle farming (including hoof care, milk production, preventive health protection) Reproduction of the cattle population (obstetric care and care of calves) Production of milk, breeding and slaughter animals Pasture farming and feed production You can find more information about the training company here: Unit 78 We offer you an attractive training allowance TVA-L an interesting and common good-oriented job in a qualified, open-minded and committed team a professionally structured, personal training a job ticket (also as a Germany ticket) 30 days of vacation per calendar year as well as days off on December 24th and 31st After the start of your training We will support you in acquiring your Class T driving license by covering a proportion of the costs. Your vocational school You attend the vocational school in the Wurzen vocational school center. Your practical training takes place in Department 78 “Teaching and Experimental Equipment” in 04886 Köllitsch. The teaching and testing facility serves as a testing and demonstration base for the LfULG and also provides inter-company training for the professions of “farmer (m/f/d)” and “animal farmer (m/f/d)” for Saxony and the southern part of Brandenburg through. Your inter-company training also takes place in Köllitsch and partly also in Löbau, Rosenhain district. At If necessary, internships in practical companies are possible. This is what you bring with a secondary school diploma, secondary school diploma or high school diploma. Enjoy working with animals and agricultural technology. Technical understanding and good observation skills. Interest in business. Willingness to work irregular working hours. The following are an advantage: basic knowledge of agriculture, for example in the form of an internship. Possession of a driving license class L or T. Yours ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application (CV, most recent school certificate) under the reference number 146/2024 as a PDF file by email to bewerbungen. lfulg@smekul. Saxony. de . Please combine the attachments in a PDF file (max. 10 MB). Your contact person is Ms. Leipert, telephone 0351 26121202. We give priority to severely disabled people and people with equal status if they have the same suitability. If you belong to this group of people, please include proof with your application

j.title: Växa Sverige söker Kokontrollexpert!
j.description: All data about cattle together with advisory services and digital tools is what we call Kokontrollen. The cow control helps our customers see the whole of their production and provides access to accurate reports, standardized sample milking, analyzes and industry comparisons. In the Cow Control & KAP department, we also work with pedigree control, whose data facilitates the customers' breeding planning and provides official pedigrees. Do you also want to be involved in developing Sweden's milk and beef production? In the position with us you will: Be a part of our Cow Control expert group and work with questions about Cow Control and KAP Have lots of customer contacts, mainly via phone and email but also visits. Assist our existing and new customers with questions regarding cow control, KAP, lineage control and our management system MinGård incl. associated functions Have good opportunities to contribute to the department's and Väx's future development based on your own interests and skills Depending on your background and your interests work with other issues, e.g. meat, pedigree verification, helping customers get started with test milking or the like. Appropriate education and experience We want that you have knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector. Maybe you have worked on a farm, as an advisor, service technician or something else. It is also advantageous if you have knowledge of e.g. meat, studbook/lineage or technical systems on farms, e.g. robotic milking or other farm systems. If you also have relevant training in animal science, farm manager or similar, it is a plus but not a requirement. As a person, you are meticulous and proactive, and talking to customers should feel easy and fun for you. You enjoy a job that contains a mixture of creative innovation and some tasks of a more routine nature. You find it easy to see opportunities, create good relationships and collaborate. We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive, great commitment and ability to meet people. The work is free and flexible and you work independently to actively plan and implement your tasks in consultation with the manager and a group of colleagues with a strong sense of community and togetherness.Scope and place of placement Full-time and permanent with placement at one of our operating locations around the country. Preferably in an area with many farms. Salary according to agreement. For more information, please contact Head of Department: Jessica Kinnander, jessica.kinnander@vxa.se 073-066 45 67 Union contact person: Pernilla Olsson, pernilla.olsson@vxa.se 070-643 51 21Application no later than 2025-01-10 Interviews may occur take place continuously. A warm welcome with your application!

j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. The work tasks involve daily care of cows, small calves and sheep in small -scale and small -scale old -fashioned operations. Cleaning and repair/maintenance of animal stables and keeping cows clean. Feeding, cleaning, fingering, feeding, in the case of cows and sheep, and sheep. Preparation of fencing (sheep and predator fencing) in 3 different grazing areas. Cleaning under electrical threads. Equestrian and cleaning wiping house. Care and maintenance of the farm's machines. (Buster Volvo BM + MF 85hp with tools sombal machines, wrappers, drag gear, chainsaw, cleaning saw, etc.) Responsible for hay harvest of about 12 hectares, be able to handle and possibly cook our bal machine, hay bales and handling traktor gear. Potatoes by hand. Maintenance and painting with linseed oil paint on the farm's barns, buildings and property. Funny carpentry with a focus on building maintenance. Keep careful order on all the farm's tools for tools and order in the farm's little carpentry. Be in its place but still be effective in the work. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. He works on various types of equipment, such as tractors, combines, seeders, and other machines used in agriculture. This role is crucial to ensure the proper functioning of agricultural equipment, minimize downtime and guarantee the productivity of agricultural operations. Required Skills and Qualities1. Maintenance and Repair: Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on agricultural machinery, replacing worn parts and adjusting settings. Diagnose breakdowns and carry out the necessary repairs to ensure the proper functioning of the equipment.2. Preventive Maintenance: Carry out regular checks to ensure the good condition of machines and prevent breakdowns. Implement a maintenance plan and ensure that interventions are carried out on time.3. Installation and Commissioning: Install new equipment and machines on farms, ensuring their conformity and proper functioning. Train users in the use of machines and basic maintenance.4. Parts Stock Management: Monitor and manage the stock of spare parts and consumables necessary for machine maintenance. Order parts and materials according to the needs identified during interventions.5. Compliance with Safety Standards: Work in accordance with the safety rules in force, using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). Raise users' awareness of safety when using machines. ConclusionThe agricultural mechanic plays a crucial role in the maintenance and proper functioning of equipment used in the agricultural sector. A BTS Maintenance of agricultural equipment or Agroequipment is a plus.Experience: Practical experience in the workshop or in the field, often acquired through apprenticeship or internships, is essential.Specific KnowledgeAgricultural equipment: Knowledge of the different types of agricultural machinery (tractors, combine harvesters, sprayers, etc.) and their operation. j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: All data about cattle together with advisory services and digital tools is what we call Kokontrollen. The cow control helps our customers see the whole of their production and provides access to accurate reports, standardized sample milking, analyzes and industry comparisons. In the Cow Control & KAP department, we also work with pedigree control, whose data facilitates the customers' breeding planning and provides official pedigrees. Do you also want to be involved in developing Sweden's milk and beef production? In the position with us you will: Be a part of our Cow Control expert group and work with questions about Cow Control and KAP Have lots of customer contacts, mainly via phone and email but also visits. Assist our existing and new customers with questions regarding cow control, KAP, lineage control and our management system MinGård incl. associated functions Have good opportunities to contribute to the department's and Väx's future development based on your own interests and skills Depending on your background and your interests work with other issues, e.g. meat, pedigree verification, helping customers get started with test milking or the like. Appropriate education and experience We want that you have knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector. Maybe you have worked on a farm, as an advisor, service technician or something else. It is also advantageous if you have knowledge of e.g. meat, studbook/lineage or technical systems on farms, e.g. robotic milking or other farm systems. If you also have relevant training in animal science, farm manager or similar, it is a plus but not a requirement. As a person, you are meticulous and proactive, and talking to customers should feel easy and fun for you. You enjoy a job that contains a mixture of creative innovation and some tasks of a more routine nature. You find it easy to see opportunities, create good relationships and collaborate. We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive, great commitment and ability to meet people. j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: About usYou don't know us yet? We are the specialist authority in Saxony responsible for the environment, nature conservation, agriculture, geology and rural development. In these areas, we particularly carry out non-profit tasks such as advice, applied research, funding, control, reporting and documentation. Department 78 "Teaching and Experimental Material" fulfills tasks in the area of ​​vocational training and further education, as a test base within the LfULG and in the demonstration of sustainable agriculture. Focus of in-company training Calf and young cattle rearing Cattle farming (including hoof care, milk production, preventive health protection) Reproduction of the cattle population (obstetric care and care of calves) Production of milk, breeding and slaughter animals Pasture farming and feed production You can find more information about the training company here: Unit 78 We offer you an attractive training allowance TVA-L an interesting and common good-oriented job in a qualified, open-minded and committed team a professionally structured, personal training a job ticket (also as a Germany ticket) 30 days of vacation per calendar year as well as days off on December 24th and 31st After the start of your training We will support you in acquiring your Class T driving license by covering a proportion of the costs. Your vocational school You attend the vocational school in the Wurzen vocational school center. Your practical training takes place in Department 78 “Teaching and Experimental Equipment” in 04886 Köllitsch. The teaching and testing facility serves as a testing and demonstration base for the LfULG and also provides inter-company training for the professions of “farmer (m/f/d)” and “animal farmer (m/f/d)” for Saxony and the southern part of Brandenburg through. Your inter-company training also takes place in Köllitsch and partly also in Löbau, Rosenhain district. At If necessary, internships in practical companies are possible. This is what you bring with a secondary school diploma, secondary school diploma or high school diploma. Enjoy working with animals and agricultural technology. Technical understanding and good observation skills. Interest in business. Willingness to work irregular working hours. The following are an advantage: basic knowledge of agriculture, for example in the form of an internship. Possession of a driving license class L or T. Yours ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application (CV, most recent school certificate) under the reference number 146/2024 as a PDF file by email to bewerbungen. lfulg@smekul. Saxony. de . Please combine the attachments in a PDF file (max. 10 MB). Your contact person is Ms. Leipert, telephone 0351 26121202. We give priority to severely disabled people and people with equal status if they have the same suitability. If you belong to this group of people, please include proof with your application

j.title: Växa Sverige söker Kokontrollexpert!
j.description: All data about cattle together with advisory services and digital tools is what we call Kokontrollen. The cow control helps our customers see the whole of their production and provides access to accurate reports, standardized sample milking, analyzes and industry comparisons. In the Cow Control & KAP department, we also work with pedigree control, whose data facilitates the customers' breeding planning and provides official pedigrees. Do you also want to be involved in developing Sweden's milk and beef production? In the position with us you will: Be a part of our Cow Control expert group and work with questions about Cow Control and KAP Have lots of customer contacts, mainly via phone and email but also visits. Assist our existing and new customers with questions regarding cow control, KAP, lineage control and our management system MinGård incl. associated functions Have good opportunities to contribute to the department's and Väx's future development based on your own interests and skills Depending on your background and your interests work with other issues, e.g. meat, pedigree verification, helping customers get started with test milking or the like. Appropriate education and experience We want that you have knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector. Maybe you have worked on a farm, as an advisor, service technician or something else. It is also advantageous if you have knowledge of e.g. meat, studbook/lineage or technical systems on farms, e.g. robotic milking or other farm systems. If you also have relevant training in animal science, farm manager or similar, it is a plus but not a requirement. As a person, you are meticulous and proactive, and talking to customers should feel easy and fun for you. You enjoy a job that contains a mixture of creative innovation and some tasks of a more routine nature. You find it easy to see opportunities, create good relationships and collaborate. We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive, great commitment and ability to meet people. The work is free and flexible and you work independently to actively plan and implement your tasks in consultation with the manager and a group of colleagues with a strong sense of community and togetherness.Scope and place of placement Full-time and permanent with placement at one of our operating locations around the country. Preferably in an area with many farms. Salary according to agreement. For more information, please contact Head of Department: Jessica Kinnander, jessica.kinnander@vxa.se 073-066 45 67 Union contact person: Pernilla Olsson, pernilla.olsson@vxa.se 070-643 51 21Application no later than 2025-01-10 Interviews may occur take place continuously. A warm welcome with your application!

j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. The work tasks involve daily care of cows, small calves and sheep in small -scale and small -scale old -fashioned operations. Cleaning and repair/maintenance of animal stables and keeping cows clean. Feeding, cleaning, fingering, feeding, in the case of cows and sheep, and sheep. Preparation of fencing (sheep and predator fencing) in 3 different grazing areas. Cleaning under electrical threads. Equestrian and cleaning wiping house. Care and maintenance of the farm's machines. (Buster Volvo BM + MF 85hp with tools sombal machines, wrappers, drag gear, chainsaw, cleaning saw, etc.) Responsible for hay harvest of about 12 hectares, be able to handle and possibly cook our bal machine, hay bales and handling traktor gear. Potatoes by hand. Maintenance and painting with linseed oil paint on the farm's barns, buildings and property. Funny carpentry with a focus on building maintenance. Keep careful order on all the farm's tools for tools and order in the farm's little carpentry. Be in its place but still be effective in the work. Other Kravj smokers, drugs or addiction problems.Svensk citizen.Social skills and communication skills. Language: Swedish housing for housing is offered in simpler caravans or the opportunity to rent a summer residence in a neighborhood. Own accommodation in a rental apartment costs about SEK 4,000/month. Duration and access season work immediately - 30/9, possibly with the possibility of extension. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. For this position, a security screening interview will be conducted before a decision on employment is made. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. In connection with your employment interview, you will receive more information about security clearance.
