j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to provide farmers with access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and quality milk production. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of the Northern Europe Region and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Merited Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / consulting experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will be based at home in the position and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Those candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

Department 78 "Teaching and Experimental Material" fulfills tasks in the area of ​​vocational training and further education, as a test base within the LfULG and in the demonstration of sustainable agriculture. Focus of in-company training Calf and young cattle rearing Cattle farming (including hoof care, milk production, preventive health protection) Reproduction of the cattle population (obstetric care and care of calves) Production of milk, breeding and slaughter animals Pasture farming and feed production You can find more information about the training company here: Unit 78 We offer you an attractive training allowance TVA-L an interesting and common good-oriented job in a qualified, open-minded and committed team a professionally structured, personal training a job ticket (also as a Germany ticket) 30 days of vacation per calendar year as well as days off on December 24th and 31st After the start of your training We will support you in acquiring your Class T driving license by covering a proportion of the costs. Your vocational school You attend the vocational school in the Wurzen vocational school center. Your inter-company training also takes place in Köllitsch and partly also in Löbau, Rosenhain district. At If necessary, internships in practical companies are possible. This is what you bring with a secondary school diploma, secondary school diploma or high school diploma. Enjoy working with animals and agricultural technology. Technical understanding and good observation skills. Interest in business. Willingness to work irregular working hours. The following are an advantage: basic knowledge of agriculture, for example in the form of an internship. Possession of a driving license class L or T. j.description: All data about cattle together with advisory services and digital tools is what we call Kokontrollen. The cow control helps our customers see the whole of their production and provides access to accurate reports, standardized sample milking, analyzes and industry comparisons. In the Cow Control & KAP department, we also work with pedigree control, whose data facilitates the customers' breeding planning and provides official pedigrees. Do you also want to be involved in developing Sweden's milk and beef production? In the position with us you will: Be a part of our Cow Control expert group and work with questions about Cow Control and KAP Have lots of customer contacts, mainly via phone and email but also visits. Assist our existing and new customers with questions regarding cow control, KAP, lineage control and our management system MinGård incl. associated functions Have good opportunities to contribute to the department's and Väx's future development based on your own interests and skills Depending on your background and your interests work with other issues, e.g. meat, pedigree verification, helping customers get started with test milking or the like. Appropriate education and experience We want that you have knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector. Maybe you have worked on a farm, as an advisor, service technician or something else. It is also advantageous if you have knowledge of e.g. meat, studbook/lineage or technical systems on farms, e.g. robotic milking or other farm systems. If you also have relevant training in animal science, farm manager or similar, it is a plus but not a requirement. As a person, you are meticulous and proactive, and talking to customers should feel easy and fun for you. You enjoy a job that contains a mixture of creative innovation and some tasks of a more routine nature. You find it easy to see opportunities, create good relationships and collaborate. We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive, great commitment and ability to meet people. j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. The work tasks involve daily care of cows, small calves and sheep in small -scale and small -scale old -fashioned operations. Cleaning and repair/maintenance of animal stables and keeping cows clean. Feeding, cleaning, fingering, feeding, in the case of cows and sheep, and sheep. Preparation of fencing (sheep and predator fencing) in 3 different grazing areas. Cleaning under electrical threads. Equestrian and cleaning wiping house. Care and maintenance of the farm's machines. (Buster Volvo BM + MF 85hp with tools sombal machines, wrappers, drag gear, chainsaw, cleaning saw, etc.) Responsible for hay harvest of about 12 hectares, be able to handle and possibly cook our bal machine, hay bales and handling traktor gear. Potatoes by hand. Maintenance and painting with linseed oil paint on the farm's barns, buildings and property. Funny carpentry with a focus on building maintenance. Keep careful order on all the farm's tools for tools and order in the farm's little carpentry. Be in its place but still be effective in the work. Other Kravj smokers, drugs or addiction problems.Svensk citizen.Social skills and communication skills. j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

He works on various types of equipment, such as tractors, combines, seeders, and other machines used in agriculture. This role is crucial to ensure the proper functioning of agricultural equipment, minimize downtime and guarantee the productivity of agricultural operations. Required Skills and Qualities1. Maintenance and Repair: Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on agricultural machinery, replacing worn parts and adjusting settings. Diagnose breakdowns and carry out the necessary repairs to ensure the proper functioning of the equipment.2. Preventive Maintenance: Carry out regular checks to ensure the good condition of machines and prevent breakdowns. Implement a maintenance plan and ensure that interventions are carried out on time.3. Installation and Commissioning: Install new equipment and machines on farms, ensuring their conformity and proper functioning. Train users in the use of machines and basic maintenance.4. Parts Stock Management: Monitor and manage the stock of spare parts and consumables necessary for machine maintenance. Order parts and materials according to the needs identified during interventions.5. Compliance with Safety Standards: Work in accordance with the safety rules in force, using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). Raise users' awareness of safety when using machines. ConclusionThe agricultural mechanic plays a crucial role in the maintenance and proper functioning of equipment used in the agricultural sector. His mastery of repair techniques, his sense of observation and his commitment to respecting safety standards are essential to guarantee the productivity and safety of agricultural operationsPosition to be filled quickly on a permanent contractSalary to be defined during an interview40 Hours per week + bonusesIntegration within a team of 10 people Prerequisites B license required Profile sought Diploma: Generally, a CAP, BEP, or Bac Pro in agricultural mechanics, maintenance of agricultural equipment, or agricultural equipment. j.title: Vi söker växtodlingsrådgivare till växtskyddscentralen i Landskrona
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position and the application are made through Stegra. DeLaval does not accept any applications for this position themselves, but refers to responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 alt. lina@stegra.nu. District salesman for SkåneNow we are looking for someone who has a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who wants to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, which is January 26, 2025, so apply today! About the role As a District Salesperson at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the Skåne district. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to provide farmers with access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluency in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driver's license B Meritorious post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as for example agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge of CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will start the position from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. For this position, a security screening interview will be conducted before a decision on employment is made. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. In connection with your employment interview, you will receive more information about security clearance. Read more about the security check at: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/Kriminalvården strives for an even gender distribution and increased diversity. Probationary employment may be applied. To submit your application, click on the application link in the advertisement. Ask questions about how to apply and submit your CV directly to Visma Recruit. Questions about specific jobs are answered by the contact person specified in the advertisement. We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies and sellers of recruitment advertisements. The Correctional Service has procured contracts.

j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.title: Kundansvarig till Biototal med arbetsområde Gävle med omnejd
j.description: CUSTOMER RESPONSIBLE FOR BIOTOTAL WITH WORK AREA GÄVLE WITH SURROUNDINGSAbout the Biototal Group: Within the Biototal Group we work for sustainable solutions between city and country with the goal of utilizing all resources so they are useful in the cycle. Through our work, we see a clear improvement when it comes to increased fertility. Our vision is to contribute to a better environment, develop long-term sustainable solutions and at the same time create financial value for the parties involved. We are expanding and are therefore looking for another colleague located in Gävle and the surrounding area. About the role: In the role of Customer Manager, you will be an intermediary to our customers such as farmers, treatment plants, industries and biogas plants. You run your work and dialogue with customers independently, while you have a committed and knowledgeable team behind you. Among other things, you will be responsible for the sale and mediation of residual products for recycling. You will also develop relationships with authorities, contractors and carriers. The work involves an exciting and varied everyday life where you will work both out in the field and from the office in Uppsala. Your work area is Gästrikland, Dalarna and Norra Uppland, which means that travel is part of the work. Sometimes with an overnight stay. B driver's license is a requirement and a company car is provided. The position is a permanent position with a start according to agreement. A trial employment may be applied at the start of the employment. Your profile: We are looking for a relationship builder with great interest and knowledge in agriculture. If you have previous experience of building long-term customer relationships in an advisory or sales role towards farmers, that is a big advantage. We would like you to have knowledge in agronomy and a basic understanding of the processes in plant nutrition. Practical experience from agriculture is highly meritorious for the role. Most likely, you have a university education as an agronomist, farm manager, farm manager or agrotechnician, alternatively you have acquired the corresponding practical knowledge in crop cultivation in another way. You are good at communicating both verbally and in writing and building relationships with customers. Furthermore, you thrive in a role where you are both given the opportunity to work in the field and with planning and documentation. As a person, you have a positive attitude, are flexible and have the ability to take your own initiative and drive your work forward. You are also used to handling the Office package and digital tools. Our offer: We offer you a free job where you can work independently, with great opportunity to influence the path towards the goal. You get a bunch of nice and curious colleagues who are passionate about creating long-term sustainable solutions in the green industry together. We offer you exciting work in a company where we always support each other in finding sustainable and long-term business plans. We care about well-being and cooperation throughout the organization. Application: We are collaborating with Paragera in this recruitment. Submit your application in the form of a CV and personal letter via the form below no later than 8/12 - 2024. If you have questions about the position, please contact our Recruitment Consultant, Annelie Haevaker, via e-mail at annelie.haevaker@paragera.se

j.description: Farmers - Farmer's description Hälsingegården & Hälsingland Lammkvalité is a smaller agriculture in the village Långhed CA6 km from Alfta along the Tourist Road Stora Hälsingegårdars väg. We who live on the farm are now pensioners and work voluntarily with the aim of preserving highly endangered land breeds, a unique cultural landscape and elderly buildings in consultation with, among other things. country associations, Swedish Agricultural Agency, Swedish cultural landscape and Gävleborgsfäbodförening. In the yard there is also a summer café and a smaller building maintenance shop. The yard is originally from the 19th century and consists of a single-modern manor building, older K-labeled Gammelgård, economy buildings and an architectural sheep house with plumbing rooms, living rooms and chicken houses. In the older barn there is room for 7fjällnära cows. In the yard there are also 15 helsing sheep, Gotland rabbits, cats and dogs. We who live in the farm are the writers and agricultural historians. The farm is run as a simpler self -catering with land and animal care, vegetable cultivation and cultural tourism in relation to the Hälsingegårdarna such as UNESCO World Heritage in traditionally distinct cultural environment. The work is of a practical distance and is varied. You should be healthy and strong and have knowledge of traditional bond knowledge. A dream job for the right person.The quality you should be energetic, have common sense and be able to work independently and effectively in a small vulnerable business where we must have confidence in each other. You should be honest and sincere. You should be able to take responsibility for both the farm's exterior and the well -being of the animals. You should have good experience in small -scale agriculture, preferably ecological focus. You should have good knowledge of ice-scale older soil management and cultivation. You should have good experience with cows, be able to handle the farm's 1-year-old breeding bull and also be able to milk the needs of the farm. Animal management is part of the business and important. You should have good animal morale and Godetics. You should also have knowledge of forest work and have chainsaw cards and cleaning saws. You should have machine knowledge, tractor habit and knowledge in carpentry, construction and maintenance. You should also be able to set up when needed overtime, for example at hay harvest or if animals can accommodate. The work tasks involve daily care of cows, small calves and sheep in small -scale and small -scale old -fashioned operations. Cleaning and repair/maintenance of animal stables and keeping cows clean. Feeding, cleaning, fingering, feeding, in the case of cows and sheep, and sheep. Preparation of fencing (sheep and predator fencing) in 3 different grazing areas. Cleaning under electrical threads. Equestrian and cleaning wiping house. Care and maintenance of the farm's machines. (Buster Volvo BM + MF 85hp with tools sombal machines, wrappers, drag gear, chainsaw, cleaning saw, etc.) Responsible for hay harvest of about 12 hectares, be able to handle and possibly cook our bal machine, hay bales and handling traktor gear. Potatoes by hand. Maintenance and painting with linseed oil paint on the farm's barns, buildings and property. Funny carpentry with a focus on building maintenance. Keep careful order on all the farm's tools for tools and order in the farm's little carpentry. Be in its place but still be effective in the work. Other Kravj smokers, drugs or addiction problems.Svensk citizen.Social skills and communication skills. Language: Swedish housing for housing is offered in simpler caravans or the opportunity to rent a summer residence in a neighborhood. Own accommodation in a rental apartment costs about SEK 4,000/month. Duration and access season work immediately - 30/9, possibly with the possibility of extension. Working time/duration part -time with the possibility of extra work. info@halsingegarden.seplatsen can be added earlier than the last application. Application via e-mail info@halsingegarden.sekompetence building maintenance, agriculture (merit) animal breeding, agriculture (merit) poultry (merit) sheep management (merit) pet maintenance (merit)

j.title: Distriktssäljare till DeLaval
j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to provide farmers with access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and quality milk production. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of the Northern Europe Region and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Merited Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / consulting experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will be based at home in the position and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Those candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

turns.content: I would like to work with breeding, feeding, and caring for animals. Are there any suitable jobs available?

Yes, there are several job opportunities available that involve breeding, feeding, and caring for animals based on the current database:

*   **Farmer as a stable manager ("Herdsman/Herdswoman") (m/f/d)**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Independent implementation and organization of the work and support of dairy cattle (feeding, milking, maintenance). Involves work in herd management, fertility, health, feeding, and breeding.
    *   **Locations:** Multiple positions available with the Bavarian state goods (BaySG) at the Ahllenschwang location.

*   **Training as a cattle carer / animal farmer / cattle farming specialist (m/f/d)**
    *   **Focus:** These training positions at the LfULG Department 78 involve calf and young cattle rearing, cattle farming (including hoof care, milk production, and preventive health protection), reproduction (obstetric care and care of calves), and the production of milk, breeding, and slaughter animals.
    *   **Note:** These are training positions based in Köllitsch, Saxony.

*   **Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Working with the acquisition, compilation, and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology, and entrepreneurship.
    *   **Requirements:** Education at university level (agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent) and experience with the entire milk production process.

*   **Farm workers farmer (plant cultivation, soil, forest, animals)**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Daily care of cows, small calves, and sheep, including feeding, milking, and animal management. Focuses on preserving endangered land breeds.
    *   **Requirements:** Experience with small-scale agriculture, experience with cows, and knowledge of traditional animal care.

*   **Växa Sverige - Kokontrollexpert**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Work with "Kokontrollen" (cow control), pedigree control, and customer support regarding cow control, KAP, and lineage control.
    *   **Requirements:** Knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector (e.g., worked on a farm, as an advisor, or service technician).

*   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding**
    *   **Note:** While primarily focused on plant breeding (specifically red clover), this role includes hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field, and contributes to food and feed production research.

These positions vary in terms of required qualifications (ranging from vocational training to university degrees) and responsibilities. Please refer to the specific job descriptions for application deadlines and contact details provided in the database records.

j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. turns.content: What qualifications or competences are needed for these roles?

Based on the information provided in the database, the core competence required for the roles listed (such as the Herdsman/Herdswoman, various cattle farming training positions, the Expert in milk production, and the Kokontrollexpert) is knowledge of **animal breeding programmes**.

The specific requirements and principles associated with this competence include:

*   **Breeding Programme Management:** Understanding the principles of managing breeding programmes, which encompasses population genetics and demographics.
*   **Legal and Policy Knowledge:** Familiarity with national and international legislation, as well as the policies and procedures of industry-relevant organisations or associations.

While the roles vary from vocational training to university-level positions, the shared requirement across these diverse roles—ranging from "Agricultural mechanic" and "Farm workers" to "PhD Student" and "Expert/project manager"—is this fundamental understanding of how breeding programmes function within the agricultural and animal production sectors.
