Description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

Description: Are you technically interested with experience in servicing and repairing heavy machinery and motivated by leading work and engaging others? Then there is now the chance to become our new foreman at Swedish Agro in Skara!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroAt Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories and manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. We continue to grow and are now looking for a second foreman for our team in Skara, which is one of our largest facilities in the country. As a foreman, you will be a key person in the workshop by leading and driving the business forward in close cooperation and will be part of a committed team that is passionate about agriculture and our customers. YOUR PRIMARY WORK TASKS Technical guidance with a focus on service As a foreman, you will be responsible for lead and distribute the work in the workshop and out in the field by supporting the entire department in the technical work. In this role, you are part of the workshop management, which consists of the workshop manager and two foremen, where you work together with the service department's 10 technicians towards clear qualitative goals. We work in a technologically modern environment that requires qualifications to administer business systems and digital aids.  Your tasks will include: Plan and lead the work in the workshop and out in the field Close cooperation with the workshop manager, sales, spare parts and other departments in the company Contact with customers Administer work orders Lead and participate in readiness during high season Machine logisticsYOUR PROFILEProblem solver who likes to lead and collaborateWe are looking for you who have a great technical interest and knowledge of heavy machinery. As a person, you like to have a lot of balls in the air, work in a varied role and have the ability to see solutions instead of problems. Collaboration comes easily to you where you have clear leadership and enjoy guiding, engaging and supporting people around you to create a good team spirit. To succeed in the role, we believe that you are motivated by challenges, have a strong drive of your own where responsibility and development are something that you are attracted to. We would like to see that you have a strong technical interest and a broad knowledge of agricultural machinery. If you have experience in agriculture, we also see that as an advantage. Furthermore, we see that you have: Experience from the agricultural/machinery industry Meritorious with technical training, preferably heavy vehicles/agricultural machinery High social skills with an understanding of customers' needs and wishes Are computer literate and a good administrator Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing B driver's license is a requirement WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best framework for well-being, development and influence. With us, you get the opportunity to undergo internal and external training so that you gain knowledge of the latest technology - we work with the most high-tech the products on the market with well-known brands ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV today or as soon as possible by clicking "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found. We believe that diversity strengthens the solution of tasks. We therefore invite all interested parties - regardless of background - to apply for the position. We hope to hear from you! AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100+ companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

Description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

Description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year.             "JobTitle: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar f\u00f6r jordbruk och djurh\u00e5llning\nDescription: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensj\u00f6 village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Sm\u00e5land forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensj\u00f6 village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensj\u00f6 include Datav\u00e4xt, V\u00e4xa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensj\u00f6 village Stensj\u00f6 village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensj\u00f6 village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Sm\u00e5land before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensj\u00f6 village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensj\u00f6 as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensj\u00f6 village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensj\u00f6 twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Sm\u00e5land's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensj\u00f6's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensj\u00f6 village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensj\u00f6 village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensj\u00f6 village several times a year. turns.content: I'm interested in occupations related to agricultural sustainability. What role would fit?

Based on the database, there are several roles related to agricultural sustainability and resource management. Here are the occupations retrieved:

*   **Sustainability Manager (Code: 1213.8):** Responsible for ensuring the sustainability of business processes, including manufacturing, products, and supply chains. They focus on waste reduction, energy efficiency, and environmental/social impacts.
*   **Agricultural Engineer (Code: 2144.1.2):** Focuses on the efficient and sustainable exploitation of land. They advise on the use of resources such as water and soil, harvesting methods, and waste management.
*   **Soil Scientist (Code: 2133.11):** Advises on improving soil quality to support nature and food production. They utilize erosion reduction measures and focus on conserving and restoring land affected by intense farming.
*   **Agricultural Equipment Design Engineer (Code: 2144.1.2.1):** Applies biological and engineering science to solve agricultural problems, specifically focusing on soil and water conservation.
*   **Agricultural Inspector (Code: 3359.1):** Monitors agricultural operations to ensure compliance with health, safety, and production legislation and standards.
*   **Mixed Farmer (Code: 6130.2):** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production, often operating as a small enterprise or for self-sufficiency.
*   **Agricultural Technician (Code: 3142.1):** Conducts tests and experiments on specimens and provides support to scientists and farmers regarding environmental conditions.
*   **Biotechnical Technician (Code: 3141.1):** Assists scientists in laboratory settings to research, develop, and test forms of biotechnology.
*   **Agriculture, Forestry and Fishery Vocational Teacher (Code: 2320.1.1):** Instructs students in practical skills and techniques required for professions in these fields.
*   **Livestock Advisor (Code: 2132.6):** Provides specialist advice to farmers and livestock breeders to optimize business and production.

Description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. JobTitle: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning
Description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

Description: Are you technically interested with experience in servicing and repairing heavy machinery and motivated by leading work and engaging others? Then there is now the chance to become our new foreman at Swedish Agro in Skara!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroAt Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories and manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. We continue to grow and are now looking for a second foreman for our team in Skara, which is one of our largest facilities in the country. As a foreman, you will be a key person in the workshop by leading and driving the business forward in close cooperation and will be part of a committed team that is passionate about agriculture and our customers. YOUR PRIMARY WORK TASKS Technical guidance with a focus on service As a foreman, you will be responsible for lead and distribute the work in the workshop and out in the field by supporting the entire department in the technical work. In this role, you are part of the workshop management, which consists of the workshop manager and two foremen, where you work together with the service department's 10 technicians towards clear qualitative goals. We work in a technologically modern environment that requires qualifications to administer business systems and digital aids.  Your tasks will include: Plan and lead the work in the workshop and out in the field Close cooperation with the workshop manager, sales, spare parts and other departments in the company Contact with customers Administer work orders Lead and participate in readiness during high season Machine logisticsYOUR PROFILEProblem solver who likes to lead and collaborateWe are looking for you who have a great technical interest and knowledge of heavy machinery. As a person, you like to have a lot of balls in the air, work in a varied role and have the ability to see solutions instead of problems. Collaboration comes easily to you where you have clear leadership and enjoy guiding, engaging and supporting people around you to create a good team spirit. To succeed in the role, we believe that you are motivated by challenges, have a strong drive of your own where responsibility and development are something that you are attracted to. We would like to see that you have a strong technical interest and a broad knowledge of agricultural machinery. If you have experience in agriculture, we also see that as an advantage. Furthermore, we see that you have: Experience from the agricultural/machinery industry Meritorious with technical training, preferably heavy vehicles/agricultural machinery High social skills with an understanding of customers' needs and wishes Are computer literate and a good administrator Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing B driver's license is a requirement WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best framework for well-being, development and influence. With us, you get the opportunity to undergo internal and external training so that you gain knowledge of the latest technology - we work with the most high-tech the products on the market with well-known brands ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV today or as soon as possible by clicking "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found. We believe that diversity strengthens the solution of tasks. We therefore invite all interested parties - regardless of background - to apply for the position. We hope to hear from you! AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100+ companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

Description: Aquila RH Montjean sur Loire is much more than just a recruitment agency. We are a team on a human scale, with the main objective of total satisfaction of our candidates/temporary workers as well as our clients. j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. j.description: Are you an expert within farm sustainability, and do you want to deliver sustainable transformation for dairy farms as a project manager and global lead for your area of expertise within Arla?With the Future26 strategy, Arla has truly put sustainability and climate at the core of the organisation. This involves taking big steps towards sustainable dairy production and carbon net zero dairy.How will you make an impact?You will act as a global lead for your area of expertise within climate efficient dairy farming. We are looking for a  new colleague who has a high level of expertise within just one of the areas listed below:1.  Plant science with a focus on feed production including nutrient management2.  Dairy cow nutrition with a focus on enteric methane and feed efficiency3.  Area-based solutions for remote-sensing or earth-observation processed mapping and verifying land use, nutrient load and/or biomass production.As one of Arla's dedicated experts in your field, you will collaborate with other experts in the team to ensure our sustainability tools - including Arla's FarmAhead Check tool - always are at the forefront of science, while balancing the need for simplicity and practical relevance for dairy farming. In addition, you:Are an experienced project manager knowing how to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farm.Work closely with our Data Scientist to activate one of the world's largest climate databases for the benefit of the green transition, creating insights to be shared with farmers (primarily) and the wider community around us. How will you be successful?With your great practical and scientific background, you are eager to be part of developing the dairy industry together with our farmer owners, the stakeholders supporting farmers, and with your local and global Arla colleagues.Moreover, you:Bring strong experience from R&D and project management. Have an agricultural scientific background and strong interest in sustainability and skills in biology linked to dairy farmingYou are curious about data and what it can be used for.  Preferably you are interested in greenhouse gas calculations, but do not necessarily need to bring experience within the areaYou are strong in explaining and communicating about complex issues - agricultural science and data - in a simple and easy to understand formatHave the ability and curiosity to work in a highly international environmentSpeak and write English effortlessly. Other languages can be an advantage.What do we offer?Join our dynamic team and thrive in an international atmosphere! We provide excellent staff benefits and opportunities for personal growth within the organization. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and be part of a supportive and innovative workplace.Arla invests significantly in sustainability. And with sustainability at the heart of our new organisation and new Future26 strategy, we are keen to step up our support of the Arla farmer owners helping them reach our ambitious sustainability and climate targets. Now you get to come along on this exciting journey.Application and contactIf you want to drive innovation and help shape the industry, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible as we will be inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis and close the position once the right candidate is found.For additional information, please call Director Hanne Bang Bligaard on +45 8938 1799.We have a purpose for Good At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?BEWARE! RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails and fake recruitment campaigns on the internet from people purporting to work for Arla Foods. Learn more via this link.#LI-HAFUG Ref.: 97201

j.description: Detail of the offerGeneral informationCompany The INVIVO group is one of the leading European agricultural groups with a turnover of nearly 12 billion euros, more than half of which is generated in France, and a workforce of more than 14,500 employees, including nearly 11,000 in France. Established in 38 countries, it brings together 90 industrial sites, including 63 in France. This pillar of food sovereignty operates across the entire value chain, from farm to fork, by being a leader in each of its four major strategic activities: International grain trading; Agriculture ; Agri-food (maltworks, wheat division, wine); Garden center and food distribution. A global cross-functional hub for innovative and digital solutions completes this system. Serving the agricultural transition, InVivo's ambition is to support the transformation of the French farm and to support European food sovereignty.  Soufflet Agriculture is the leading French private collector of cereals and oilseeds. Present in the main arable crop regions in France as well as in Europe and the CIS, the company ensures the collection, storage and marketing of agricultural production, and carries out agro-supplies distribution activity. Soufflet Agriculture supports farmers in their development through personalized agronomic expertise, technical monitoring and the provision of innovative and competitive solutions to meet the needs of the agri-food sectors and industries. As a business owner, you embody the business and management vision, ensure that this is translated into concrete digital initiatives with added business value and participate in the definition of Soufflet Agriculture's digital roadmap. You manage the progress of digital initiatives in your area, in coordination with the digital and technical teams of the INVIVO group, and report progress, alerts and risks to the project sponsors. You ensure the proper expression of needs and the proper functioning of functionalities delivered, relying in particular on a network of professional experts within Soufflet Agriculture.YOUR DAILY Understand and convey the strategic vision of the Soufflet Agriculture Department in your fieldEnsure the expression and consideration of professional, market and business needs in the identification and development of new digital initiatives Lead a team of French and International business experts, referents to obtain and specify needs with a French and International vision Manage the delivery of functionalities and guarantee compliance with deadlines Report gaps / points of attention and propose arbitrations with Soufflet Agriculture sponsors Participate in the digital project steering bodies and carry out the necessary reporting Carry out tests and validate new functionalities with the support of business experts Participate in the deployment of functionalities in your field to users Profile YOUR PROFILE Higher type training bac +5 in agro/agri, you have strong experience in the field of cooperatives or agricultural trading, and in the management of collection and sale flows of agrosupplies. You have a strong attraction for digital tools and a good knowledge of the latest innovations in the agricultural sector. You have already participated in or managed solution development projects (ideally digital). j.upload_date: 2024-09-17T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", "j.title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals
j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

j.upload_date: 2024-10-10T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", "j.title: Distriktssäljare till DeLaval
j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Meritorious Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will work from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

j.description: Are you an expert within farm sustainability, and do you want to deliver sustainable transformation for dairy farms as a project manager and global lead for your area of expertise within Arla?With the Future26 strategy, Arla has truly put sustainability and climate at the core of the organisation. This involves taking big steps towards sustainable dairy production and carbon net zero dairy.How will you make an impact?You will act as a global lead for your area of expertise within climate efficient dairy farming. We are looking for a  new colleague who has a high level of expertise within just one of the areas listed below:1.  Plant science with a focus on feed production including nutrient management2.  Dairy cow nutrition with a focus on enteric methane and feed efficiency3.  Area-based solutions for remote-sensing or earth-observation processed mapping and verifying land use, nutrient load and/or biomass production.As one of Arla's dedicated experts in your field, you will collaborate with other experts in the team to ensure our sustainability tools - including Arla's FarmAhead Check tool - always are at the forefront of science, while balancing the need for simplicity and practical relevance for dairy farming. In addition, you:Are an experienced project manager knowing how to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farm.Work closely with our Data Scientist to activate one of the world's largest climate databases for the benefit of the green transition, creating insights to be shared with farmers (primarily) and the wider community around us. How will you be successful?With your great practical and scientific background, you are eager to be part of developing the dairy industry together with our farmer owners, the stakeholders supporting farmers, and with your local and global Arla colleagues.Moreover, you:Bring strong experience from R&D and project management. Have an agricultural scientific background and strong interest in sustainability and skills in biology linked to dairy farmingYou are curious about data and what it can be used for.  Preferably you are interested in greenhouse gas calculations, but do not necessarily need to bring experience within the areaYou are strong in explaining and communicating about complex issues - agricultural science and data - in a simple and easy to understand formatHave the ability and curiosity to work in a highly international environmentSpeak and write English effortlessly. Other languages can be an advantage.What do we offer?Join our dynamic team and thrive in an international atmosphere! We provide excellent staff benefits and opportunities for personal growth within the organization. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and be part of a supportive and innovative workplace.Arla invests significantly in sustainability. And with sustainability at the heart of our new organisation and new Future26 strategy, we are keen to step up our support of the Arla farmer owners helping them reach our ambitious sustainability and climate targets. Now you get to come along on this exciting journey.Application and contactIf you want to drive innovation and help shape the industry, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible as we will be inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis and close the position once the right candidate is found.For additional information, please call Director Hanne Bang Bligaard on +45 8938 1799.We have a purpose for Good At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?BEWARE! RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails and fake recruitment campaigns on the internet from people purporting to work for Arla Foods. Learn more via this link.#LI-HAFUG Ref.: 97201
