j.description: Detail of the offerGeneral informationCompany The INVIVO group is one of the leading European agricultural groups with a turnover of nearly 12 billion euros, more than half of which is generated in France, and a workforce of more than 14,500 employees, including nearly 11,000 in France. Established in 38 countries, it brings together 90 industrial sites, including 63 in France. This pillar of food sovereignty operates across the entire value chain, from farm to fork, by being a leader in each of its four major strategic activities: International grain trading; Agriculture ; Agri-food (maltworks, wheat division, wine); Garden center and food distribution. A global cross-functional hub for innovative and digital solutions completes this system. Serving the agricultural transition, InVivo's ambition is to support the transformation of the French farm and to support European food sovereignty.  Soufflet Agriculture is the leading French private collector of cereals and oilseeds. Present in the main arable crop regions in France as well as in Europe and the CIS, the company ensures the collection, storage and marketing of agricultural production, and carries out agro-supplies distribution activity. Soufflet Agriculture supports farmers in their development through personalized agronomic expertise, technical monitoring and the provision of innovative and competitive solutions to meet the needs of the agri-food sectors and industries.  Category of the offerStandardJob descriptionSectorINFORMATION SYSTEMSTitle of the posterdigital domain manager F/HContractCDI INDETERMINED DURATIONSocio-professional categoryFrameworkWorking timeFull timeMission descriptionTHE JOB IN A FEW WORDSYou are joining the Soufflet Agriculture team as part of a strategic digital project for the company. As a business owner, you embody the business and management vision, ensure that this is translated into concrete digital initiatives with added business value and participate in the definition of Soufflet Agriculture's digital roadmap. You manage the progress of digital initiatives in your area, in coordination with the digital and technical teams of the INVIVO group, and report progress, alerts and risks to the project sponsors. You ensure the proper expression of needs and the proper functioning of functionalities delivered, relying in particular on a network of professional experts within Soufflet Agriculture.YOUR DAILY Understand and convey the strategic vision of the Soufflet Agriculture Department in your fieldEnsure the expression and consideration of professional, market and business needs in the identification and development of new digital initiatives Lead a team of French and International business experts, referents to obtain and specify needs with a French and International vision Manage the delivery of functionalities and guarantee compliance with deadlines Report gaps / points of attention and propose arbitrations with Soufflet Agriculture sponsors Participate in the digital project steering bodies and carry out the necessary reporting Carry out tests and validate new functionalities with the support of business experts Participate in the deployment of functionalities in your field to users Profile YOUR PROFILE Higher type training bac +5 in agro/agri, you have strong experience in the field of cooperatives or agricultural trading, and in the management of collection and sale flows of agrosupplies. You have a strong attraction for digital tools and a good knowledge of the latest innovations in the agricultural sector. You have already participated in or managed solution development projects (ideally digital). You have a good command of English, both written and spoken, and are able to discuss with experts on their field and their needs in France and internationally. You have an appetite for teamwork and management in the context of complex projects with numerous contacts. Equipped with a critical, rigorous mind, you are capable of analyzing and synthesizing complex issues for arbitration purposes by Management. You are comfortable with project management methods, the formalization of documents and the use of office tools (PPT, Excel, etc.)Location of the positionLocation of the positionEurope, FranceCityNOGENT SUR SEINE Candidate criteriaMinimum level of experience. required2-5 yearsLanguagesEnglish (Good level)

j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

j.upload_date: 2024-10-10T00:00:00.000000000+00:00", "j.title: Distriktssäljare till DeLaval
j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Meritorious Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will work from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

j.description: Are you an expert within farm sustainability, and do you want to deliver sustainable transformation for dairy farms as a project manager and global lead for your area of expertise within Arla?With the Future26 strategy, Arla has truly put sustainability and climate at the core of the organisation. This involves taking big steps towards sustainable dairy production and carbon net zero dairy.How will you make an impact?You will act as a global lead for your area of expertise within climate efficient dairy farming. We are looking for a  new colleague who has a high level of expertise within just one of the areas listed below:1.  Plant science with a focus on feed production including nutrient management2.  Dairy cow nutrition with a focus on enteric methane and feed efficiency3.  Area-based solutions for remote-sensing or earth-observation processed mapping and verifying land use, nutrient load and/or biomass production.As one of Arla's dedicated experts in your field, you will collaborate with other experts in the team to ensure our sustainability tools - including Arla's FarmAhead Check tool - always are at the forefront of science, while balancing the need for simplicity and practical relevance for dairy farming. In addition, you:Are an experienced project manager knowing how to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farm.Work closely with our Data Scientist to activate one of the world's largest climate databases for the benefit of the green transition, creating insights to be shared with farmers (primarily) and the wider community around us. How will you be successful?With your great practical and scientific background, you are eager to be part of developing the dairy industry together with our farmer owners, the stakeholders supporting farmers, and with your local and global Arla colleagues.Moreover, you:Bring strong experience from R&D and project management. Have an agricultural scientific background and strong interest in sustainability and skills in biology linked to dairy farmingYou are curious about data and what it can be used for.  Preferably you are interested in greenhouse gas calculations, but do not necessarily need to bring experience within the areaYou are strong in explaining and communicating about complex issues - agricultural science and data - in a simple and easy to understand formatHave the ability and curiosity to work in a highly international environmentSpeak and write English effortlessly. Other languages can be an advantage.What do we offer?Join our dynamic team and thrive in an international atmosphere! We provide excellent staff benefits and opportunities for personal growth within the organization. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and be part of a supportive and innovative workplace.Arla invests significantly in sustainability. And with sustainability at the heart of our new organisation and new Future26 strategy, we are keen to step up our support of the Arla farmer owners helping them reach our ambitious sustainability and climate targets. Now you get to come along on this exciting journey.Application and contactIf you want to drive innovation and help shape the industry, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible as we will be inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis and close the position once the right candidate is found.For additional information, please call Director Hanne Bang Bligaard on +45 8938 1799.We have a purpose for Good At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?BEWARE! RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails and fake recruitment campaigns on the internet from people purporting to work for Arla Foods. Learn more via this link.#LI-HAFUG Ref.: 97201

Established in 38 countries, it brings together 90 industrial sites, including 63 in France. This pillar of food sovereignty operates across the entire value chain, from farm to fork, by being a leader in each of its four major strategic activities: International grain trading; Agriculture ; Agri-food (maltworks, wheat division, wine); Garden center and food distribution. A global cross-functional hub for innovative and digital solutions completes this system. Serving the agricultural transition, InVivo's ambition is to support the transformation of the French farm and to support European food sovereignty.  Soufflet Agriculture is the leading French private collector of cereals and oilseeds. Present in the main arable crop regions in France as well as in Europe and the CIS, the company ensures the collection, storage and marketing of agricultural production, and carries out agro-supplies distribution activity. Soufflet Agriculture supports farmers in their development through personalized agronomic expertise, technical monitoring and the provision of innovative and competitive solutions to meet the needs of the agri-food sectors and industries. j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

            "j.title: Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager\nj.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? S\u00f6dert\u00e4lje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of S\u00f6dert\u00e4lje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in S\u00f6dert\u00e4lje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of S\u00f6dert\u00e4lje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. S\u00f6dert\u00e4lje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.\nj.upload_date: 2024-11-06T00:00:00.000000000+00:00",
            "j.title: Senior Farm Sustainability Specialist - Viby, Stockholm or D\u00fcsseldorf.             "j.title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals\nj.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of J\u00e4mtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd\nj.upload_date: 2024-10-10T00:00:00.000000000+00:00",

            "j.title: Distriktss\u00e4ljare till DeLaval\nj.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Sk\u00e5ne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamrag\u00e5rd in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Meritorious Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will work from home and live and work in Sk\u00e5ne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina S\u00f6dergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.\nj.upload_date: 2025-01-06T00:00:00.000000000+00:00",

turns.content: Are there any jobs available for a Project Manager?

Yes, there are several job opportunities for a Project Manager within the agricultural sector as described in the provided information:

*   **Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals:** This role involves planning, implementing, and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy. It requires experience in project management, writing applications for project funds, and coordinating actors for various activities. 
*   **Digital domain manager (F/M):** This role at Soufflet Agriculture involves managing the progress of digital initiatives, reporting risks to project sponsors, and leading a team of business experts. It requires experience in solution development projects.
*   **Distriktssäljare (District Salesperson) at DeLaval:** This role in Skåne involves coordinating and project managing the work for builders, authorities, and advisory bodies when planning facilities and systems for farmers. Experience in project management is listed as a meritorious qualification.
*   **Researchers in ecosystem services in strip cultivation:** This position involves planning cultivation experiments, field work, and project management. Experience in project management is a qualification.
*   **Responsable de pôle installation en agriculture (F/H):** This role involves providing local supervision to a team of managers, leading regional installation policy, and organizing/coordinating various processes. 
*   **Samordnare för stadsnära odling (Coordinator for urban cultivation):** This role includes project management and cross-sectoral collaboration for the development of urban cultivation.
*   **Senior Farm Sustainability Specialist:** This role involves acting as a project manager to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farms.
*   **Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager:** This role involves leading projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, supporting professional horticulture and agriculture, and developing recreational and complementary cultivation. It requires experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration.

j.title: Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager
j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

j.title: Senior Farm Sustainability Specialist - Viby, Stockholm or Düsseldorf. Remote working is possible.
j.description: Are you an expert within farm sustainability, and do you want to deliver sustainable transformation for dairy farms as a project manager and global lead for your area of expertise within Arla?With the Future26 strategy, Arla has truly put sustainability and climate at the core of the organisation. This involves taking big steps towards sustainable dairy production and carbon net zero dairy.How will you make an impact?You will act as a global lead for your area of expertise within climate efficient dairy farming. We are looking for a  new colleague who has a high level of expertise within just one of the areas listed below:1.  Plant science with a focus on feed production including nutrient management2.  Dairy cow nutrition with a focus on enteric methane and feed efficiency3.  Area-based solutions for remote-sensing or earth-observation processed mapping and verifying land use, nutrient load and/or biomass production.As one of Arla's dedicated experts in your field, you will collaborate with other experts in the team to ensure our sustainability tools - including Arla's FarmAhead Check tool - always are at the forefront of science, while balancing the need for simplicity and practical relevance for dairy farming. In addition, you:Are an experienced project manager knowing how to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farm.Work closely with our Data Scientist to activate one of the world's largest climate databases for the benefit of the green transition, creating insights to be shared with farmers (primarily) and the wider community around us. Have an agricultural scientific background and strong interest in sustainability and skills in biology linked to dairy farmingYou are curious about data and what it can be used for.  Preferably you are interested in greenhouse gas calculations, but do not necessarily need to bring experience within the areaYou are strong in explaining and communicating about complex issues - agricultural science and data - in a simple and easy to understand formatHave the ability and curiosity to work in a highly international environmentSpeak and write English effortlessly. Other languages can be an advantage.What do we offer?Join our dynamic team and thrive in an international atmosphere! We provide excellent staff benefits and opportunities for personal growth within the organization. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and be part of a supportive and innovative workplace.Arla invests significantly in sustainability. And with sustainability at the heart of our new organisation and new Future26 strategy, we are keen to step up our support of the Arla farmer owners helping them reach our ambitious sustainability and climate targets. Now you get to come along on this exciting journey.Application and contactIf you want to drive innovation and help shape the industry, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible as we will be inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis and close the position once the right candidate is found.For additional information, please call Director Hanne Bang Bligaard on +45 8938 1799.We have a purpose for Good At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. Established in 38 countries, it brings together 90 industrial sites, including 63 in France. Serving the agricultural transition, InVivo's ambition is to support the transformation of the French farm and to support European food sovereignty.  Soufflet Agriculture is the leading French private collector of cereals and oilseeds. Present in the main arable crop regions in France as well as in Europe and the CIS, the company ensures the collection, storage and marketing of agricultural production, and carries out agro-supplies distribution activity. Soufflet Agriculture supports farmers in their development through personalized agronomic expertise, technical monitoring and the provision of innovative and competitive solutions to meet the needs of the agri-food sectors and industries. j.title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals
j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

j.title: Distriktssäljare till DeLaval
j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Meritorious Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will work from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

turns.content: What other occupations use the last skill you mentioned?

The last skill mentioned in the previous response was **"Lead a team"** (in the context of managing projects and supervising groups). 

Based on the information available in my database, here are several occupations that incorporate the skill of leading and managing teams:

*   **Agricultural scientist:** These professionals plan and implement projects, which often involves leading teams to conduct research on soil, animals, and plants to improve agricultural processes.
*   **Aquaculture hatchery manager:** This role involves directing and coordinating production in large-scale operations. They supervise teams responsible for the breeding, incubation, and early-life rearing stages of fish and shellfish.
*   **Product development manager:** These managers coordinate the development of new products from beginning to end, which requires leading cross-functional teams to balance design, technical requirements, and cost criteria.
*   **Performance lighting designer:** While focused on artistic vision, these designers supervise the execution of their concepts by coaching technical operators and working closely with an entire artistic team.
*   **Sound operator:** Similar to other performance-based roles, these professionals lead the technical execution of a performance by supervising the setup and steering the technical crew to ensure the sound system is operated effectively.
*   **Automated fly bar operator:** This high-risk occupation involves supervising the setup of rigging systems and steering the technical crew to ensure the safe movement of heavy loads during a performance.
*   **Zoo educator:** Depending on the size of the organization, these professionals may lead or coordinate a large team of educators to develop formal and informal learning opportunities for visitors. 

While the context returned by the database does not provide an exhaustive list of every job title in existence, these roles represent the specific occupations identified that involve the coordination and leadership of personnel and projects.
