j.id: 1708081",
            "j.title: Phd position within Sustainable Feed for Poultry and Pigs
j.description: Department of Applied Animal Science and WelfareThe goal at our institution is to promote good animal husbandry and animal welfare as well as sustainable food production with high product quality. We do this through research and education on animals with a focus on feed and nutrition, management and the environment, ethology, animal ethics and animal welfare. We are about 125 employees working in Uppsala, Skara, Umeå and Gothenburg.As a PhD student, you will be in a creative and stimulating environment with the opportunity to network with both the business community and international contacts.More information about the department: Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare.Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Research project: Sustainable feed for poultry and pigsResearch subject: Animal ScienceDescription:Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare, Lantmännen and the competence centre SustAinimal work together to explore the role of livestock for future increased, sustainable and competitive food production in Sweden. Focus is profitable solutions delivering food and ecosystem services in various parts of the food sector.In Swedish poultry and pig production, feed accounts for the majority of both the production costs and the global warming potential. The animals' feed conversion ratio and the choice of feed ingredients thus have a significant impact on the production's climate impact. In addition to the climate impact, contributions to biodiversity, circularity, competition between feed and food, and self-sufficiency are important sustainability parameters. Future animal production needs feed that can meet these upcoming challenges without losing profitability and competitiveness. Possible strategies could include a higher proportion of feed ingredients produced from side streams and materials unsuitable for human consumption.This project aims to develop and evaluate new feed compositions with the goal of reduced environmental impact, increased self-sufficiency, and increased use of feed ingredients produced from side streams, all while maintaining good profitability.Work tasks: The work involves planning, organizing, and doing practical work while conducting animal trials at SLU's research facility Swedish Livestock Research Centre. The tasks also include compiling, statistically analyzing, and publishing results from the conducted studies, as well as working with databases and sustainability assessments.As a doctoral student, the responsibilities includes oral presentations and written publications of the project in scientific and popular science contexts. The doctoral student is also expected to participate in teaching activities at both undergraduate and advanced levels.Qualifications:At the time of employment, a degree at advanced level is required for the position. We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Agricultural Science, a Master's degree in Animal Science, Biology, or another relevant field. You must also have documented good knowledge in written and spoken English. Knowledge of Swedish or other Nordic languages is considered an advantage. A driver's license for car is also an advantage.Previous experience in statistical data analysis, working with databases and sustainability assessments, strong computer skills, and working with pigs or poultry and their feeding is considered advantageous. An interest in Swedish animal production is also seen as a merit.Great importance will be placed on strong collaboration skills, the ability to work independently, and personal suitability for the tasks.Place of work: UppsalaForms for funding or employment:Employed as PhD student 100 % full-time (4 years education)Starting date:According to agreement.Application:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-01-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
j.id: 1751148",
            "j.title: Business manager for the new center for sustainable primary production
j.description: The unit for cooperation and development Do you want to take a key role in the development of knowledge for a sustainable primary production of food? Through an investment in the future, in collaboration between Sparbanken Skåne and SLU, this knowledge center is now being established, which will take advantage of Skåne's excellent conditions for sustainable food production through knowledge, innovation and new technical opportunities in collaboration between academia and the agricultural and horticultural industries. We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

turns.content: I want to work on sustainable energy solutions. Which occupation would fit me?

Based on the available information from the database, there are numerous occupations focused on sustainable energy solutions. Depending on your specific interest in design, maintenance, consulting, or sales, you might consider the following roles:

*   **Engineering & Design:**
    *   **Renewable energy engineer:** Researches alternative energy sources and designs systems to optimize production and reduce environmental strain.
    *   **Energy engineer:** Designs new, efficient, and clean ways to produce and distribute energy, focusing on sustainability.
    *   **Solar energy engineer:** Designs systems to generate electricity from sunlight.
    *   **Onshore wind energy engineer:** Designs, installs, and maintains wind energy farms.
    *   **Offshore renewable energy engineer:** Manages the installation and design of offshore energy farms and tests equipment like wave and tidal generators.
    *   **Alternative fuels engineer:** Designs systems and motors that use renewable/non-fossil fuels like biodiesel, biomass, or hydrogen.
    *   **Hydropower engineer:** Plans and designs facilities that generate electricity from the movement of water.
    *   **Electric power generation engineer:** Develops systems for electrical power generation with a focus on sustainable and efficient solutions.
    *   **Energy systems engineer:** Supervises energy conversion and distribution, focusing on improving efficiency and integrating renewable energy.

*   **Consulting & Analysis:**
    *   **Energy consultant:** Advises clients on energy sources and how to reduce their carbon footprint.
    *   **Renewable energy consultant:** Provides specialized advice on the advantages of different renewable energy sources.
    *   **Energy manager:** Coordinates energy use within an organization to implement sustainability policies and minimize environmental impact.
    *   **Energy analyst:** Evaluates energy consumption in buildings and recommends cost-effective, efficient alternatives.
    *   **Energy assessor:** Determines energy performance for buildings and advises on energy conservation.
    *   **Energy conservation officer:** Promotes energy conservation and enforces efficiency improvements in homes and businesses.

*   **Technical & Sales Support:**
    *   **Hydropower technician:** Installs and maintains hydropower plant systems.
    *   **Geothermal technician:** Installs and maintains geothermal power and heating installations.
    *   **Renewable energy sales representative:** Promotes renewable energy products and secures sales for renewable energy suppliers.
    *   **Solar energy sales consultant:** Advises clients on solar energy to promote it as a sustainable alternative.

j.description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. For this position, a security screening interview will be conducted before a decision on employment is made. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. In connection with your employment interview, you will receive more information about security clearance. Questions about specific jobs are answered by the contact person specified in the advertisement. j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.title: Phd position within Sustainable Feed for Poultry and Pigs
j.description: Department of Applied Animal Science and WelfareThe goal at our institution is to promote good animal husbandry and animal welfare as well as sustainable food production with high product quality. We do this through research and education on animals with a focus on feed and nutrition, management and the environment, ethology, animal ethics and animal welfare. We are about 125 employees working in Uppsala, Skara, Umeå and Gothenburg.As a PhD student, you will be in a creative and stimulating environment with the opportunity to network with both the business community and international contacts.More information about the department: Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare.Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Research project: Sustainable feed for poultry and pigsResearch subject: Animal ScienceDescription:Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare, Lantmännen and the competence centre SustAinimal work together to explore the role of livestock for future increased, sustainable and competitive food production in Sweden. Focus is profitable solutions delivering food and ecosystem services in various parts of the food sector.In Swedish poultry and pig production, feed accounts for the majority of both the production costs and the global warming potential. The animals' feed conversion ratio and the choice of feed ingredients thus have a significant impact on the production's climate impact. In addition to the climate impact, contributions to biodiversity, circularity, competition between feed and food, and self-sufficiency are important sustainability parameters. Future animal production needs feed that can meet these upcoming challenges without losing profitability and competitiveness. Possible strategies could include a higher proportion of feed ingredients produced from side streams and materials unsuitable for human consumption.This project aims to develop and evaluate new feed compositions with the goal of reduced environmental impact, increased self-sufficiency, and increased use of feed ingredients produced from side streams, all while maintaining good profitability.Work tasks: The work involves planning, organizing, and doing practical work while conducting animal trials at SLU's research facility Swedish Livestock Research Centre. The tasks also include compiling, statistically analyzing, and publishing results from the conducted studies, as well as working with databases and sustainability assessments.As a doctoral student, the responsibilities includes oral presentations and written publications of the project in scientific and popular science contexts. The doctoral student is also expected to participate in teaching activities at both undergraduate and advanced levels.Qualifications:At the time of employment, a degree at advanced level is required for the position. We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Agricultural Science, a Master's degree in Animal Science, Biology, or another relevant field. You must also have documented good knowledge in written and spoken English. Knowledge of Swedish or other Nordic languages is considered an advantage. A driver's license for car is also an advantage.Previous experience in statistical data analysis, working with databases and sustainability assessments, strong computer skills, and working with pigs or poultry and their feeding is considered advantageous. An interest in Swedish animal production is also seen as a merit.Great importance will be placed on strong collaboration skills, the ability to work independently, and personal suitability for the tasks.Place of work: UppsalaForms for funding or employment:Employed as PhD student 100 % full-time (4 years education)Starting date:According to agreement.Application:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-01-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. j.title: Chef till funktionen Jordbrukarstöd
j.description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt

turns.content: What other occupations require the last skill you mentioned?

The skill referred to in your previous request is **"Promote sustainable energy"** (identified by ID `http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/0e81fcff-2fb5-4c87-afc2-49b5e5d9db50`).

According to the provided database, the following occupations require this skill:

*   **Anaerobic digestion plant operator:** They oversee and maintain the process of breaking down organic matter (such as food waste) in the absence of oxygen to produce biogas. Their responsibilities include monitoring performance, troubleshooting issues, and conducting regular inspections of the process.
*   **Biogas technician:** They work in the derivation of gas from organic matter (produced as landfill gas or digested gas). Their tasks include operating equipment in biogas plants, performing tests, carrying out maintenance, and taking action in the event of system failures.
